narrative_text: An AWB for a 14-piece bicycle shipment with 2 dangerous goods batteries was rebooked onto a new flight after a gate change caused the original cart to be refused and returned to the warehouse. During replanning the NOTOC screen displayed NO DG instead of showing the hidden DG window, so the shipment was manifested and dispatched without a dangerous goods declaration to destination. Please flag this AWB and cart for review, and follow up with the duty manager on urgent NOTOC/DG rebooking training, since this was missed during onboarding.
summary: A DG shipment was replanned onto a new flight without a proper NOTOC declaration because the system defaulted to showing NO DG, requiring urgent review and staff training follow-up.

narrative_text: Shehena ya baiskeli vipande 14 pamoja na betri mbili za kemikali hatari (DG) ilibidi ipangiwe ndege nyingine baada ya lango kubadilika na gari la mizigo kukataliwa, kisha kurudishwa ghalani. Wakati wa kupanga upya safari, mfumo ulionyesha HAKUNA DG badala ya kufungua dirisha maalum la taarifa za mizigo hatari, hivyo mzigo ukasafirishwa nje ya nchi bila taarifa sahihi ya NOTOC. Tafadhali fuatilia hati hii ya usafirishaji na uhakikishe menejimenti inatoa mafunzo ya haraka kuhusu upangaji upya wa mizigo hatari, kwani jambo hili halikufundishwa awali.
summary: Mzigo wenye vitu hatari ulipangiwa ndege nyingine bila taarifa sahihi ya NOTOC kwa sababu mfumo ulionyesha hakuna DG, hivyo inahitajika ufuatiliaji wa haraka na mafunzo kwa wafanyakazi.

narrative_text: Ile AWB ya bicycle 14 pieces na 2 DG batteries ilibidi i-replan kwa flight mpya baada ya gate kubadilika na cart ikarefuse, ikarudi warehouse. Nikienda replan kwenye system, screen ya NOTOC ikaonyesha NO DG badala ya kuopen ile hidden window ya DG details, so nikaenda ahead ni-manifest flight bila declaration sahihi mpaka destination ya international. Tafadhali fuatilia hii AWB na cart, halafu tuongee na duty manager kuhusu training ya DG rebooking kwa sababu hii process haikufundishwa during onboarding.
summary: AWB ya DG shipment iliishia kupangwa flight bila proper NOTOC declaration kwa sababu system ilishow NO DG, so tunahitaji follow-up na training ya haraka.

narrative_text: During base check on the Citation Longitude, we found the LH outboard split flap rubbing against the aileron panel and excessive play in the inboard actuator fairing on the same wing. This was flagged to management and the oncoming lead tech at shift turnover, with the damage physically shown to one of the incoming managers. Flap removal for evaluation is now planned given the tight ETIC, but crew is split with leading edge and fuel tank inspections also open, so follow-up on the flap actuator damage assessment is needed from the next shift.
summary: Technicians found flap rubbing and actuator fairing play on a Citation Longitude LH wing during base check, handed over for further evaluation amid time pressure.

entities.text: leading edge and fuel tank inspections

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa msingi kwenye ndege ya Citation Longitude, tulibaini bapa la nje la flap upande wa kushoto likigusana na paneli ya aileron, pamoja na mchezo mkubwa kwenye sehemu ya ndani ya actuator ya mrengo huohuo. Hali hii iliripotiwa kwa uongozi na fundi kiongozi aliyekuwa akiingia zamu, na hata uharibifu ulionyeshwa moja kwa moja kwa mmoja wa mameneja. Kutokana na muda mfupi uliopangwa wa kukamilisha kazi, imeamuliwa flap iondolewe kwa ukaguzi zaidi, lakini kwa kuwa wafanyakazi wamegawanywa kufanya ukaguzi wa ukingo wa mbele na matangi ya mafuta, ufuatiliaji wa tathmini ya uharibifu wa actuator unahitajika kutoka kwa zamu inayofuata.
summary: Mafundi waligundua flap ikigusana na aileron pamoja na mchezo mkubwa wa actuator kwenye ndege ya Citation Longitude wakati wa ukaguzi, na kukabidhi suala hilo kwa zamu inayofuata kwa ufuatiliaji zaidi.

entities.text: bapa la nje la flap upande wa kushoto
ukaguzi wa ukingo wa mbele na matangi ya mafuta

narrative_text: Tuko na base check ya Citation Longitude, tukapata LH outboard flap ikigusana na aileron panel, na actuator fairing ya inboard ina play mob sana. Nilitoa turnover kwa management na lead tech aliyekuwa amekuja, hata nikamuonyesha manager mmoja damage ile physically. Sasa wamesema flap iondolewe for evaluation kwa sababu ETIC ni tight, but crew imegawanyika na tuko na leading edge inspection na fuel tank checks pia, so next shift wafuatilie assessment ya actuator damage.
summary: Base check ya Citation Longitude ilipata flap rubbing na actuator play, tumeshahandover kwa management ili wafuatilie evaluation zaidi.

narrative_text: During #2 Engine Oil Cooler shroud reinstallation on the Q400, dayshift picked up from graves but ran engines to warm oil without the printed Oil Pressure Check and Adjustment task (Para 5E) onboard; only the Installation and Leak Check tasks were referenced. Oil temp was brought up to low-mid 60s from memory, missing the required 80% NH parameter, though pressure looked normal during the run. Leak check after shutdown was clean and the non-routine was signed off, but next shift must pull Para 5E and verify the oil pressure check/adjustment was actually completed per task before further flight release review.
summary: Oil Cooler task card follow-up was signed off without completing the required Oil Pressure Check and Adjustment step (Para 5E), which needs verification by next shift.

entities.text: Oil Pressure Check and Adjustment task (Para 5E)

narrative_text: Wakati wa kufunga tena shroud ya Oil Cooler ya Injini namba 2 kwenye ndege ya Q400, shift ya mchana ilipokea kazi kutoka shift ya usiku na kuendesha injini kupasha mafuta bila kuwa na task ya Oil Pressure Check and Adjustment (Para 5E) ikiwa imechapishwa na kuwekwa ndani ya ndege. Joto la mafuta lilifikishwa kiasi cha miongo ya sitini kwa kumbukumbu tu, bila kuzingatia kigezo cha 80% NH kilichotakiwa, ingawa presha ya mafuta ilionekana ya kawaida wakati wa majaribio. Ukaguzi wa uvujaji baada ya kuzima injini haukuonyesha tatizo na fomu ya non-routine ilisainiwa, lakini shift inayofuata inatakiwa kuangalia tena Para 5E na kuthibitisha kama ukaguzi wa presha ya mafuta ulifanyika kikamilifu kabla ya kuidhinisha ndege kurudi kazini.
summary: Kazi ya kuangalia na kurekebisha presha ya mafuta (Para 5E) haikukamilika kabla ya kusainiwa kwa fomu, hivyo shift inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha.

entities.text: shroud ya Oil Cooler ya Injini namba 2

narrative_text: Tulipokea turnover kutoka night shift kwenye Q400 #2 Engine Oil Cooler shroud reinstallation, tukaenda mbele na engine runs kupasha oil lakini bila kuwa na printed copy ya Oil Pressure Check and Adjustment task, Para 5E, on board — tulikuwa na Installation na Leak Check tasks tu. Oil temp tuliifikisha low-mid 60s from memory, tukamiss ile requirement ya 80% NH, japo oil pressure ilikuwa ikionekana normal during the run. Leak check baada ya shutdown ilikuwa clean na non-routine ikasignwa, lakini next shift wanahitaji ku-pull Para 5E na kuconfirm kama oil pressure check/adjustment ilikamilika kabla ya kuclear ndege for release.
summary: Task ya Oil Pressure Check and Adjustment (Para 5E) haikucompletewa kabla ya sign-off, kwa hivyo next shift wanahitaji kuverify.

narrative_text: On the B737-500, corrosion was found on the upper wing skin below the overwing exit while working the left wing; Quality Control and Engineering were notified and an NRC was raised. Engineering instructed blending until corrosion was fully removed, but the blended area was then found out of limits, so the aircraft is on hold pending a revised repair from Engineering. Wing tanks still need to be opened for the repair; note that some blended fastener locations were not captured on the maintenance form, though dayshift was verbally briefed on this by the supervisor and Quality Control. Please confirm this fastener detail gets documented properly before further work proceeds.
summary: Wing skin corrosion on the B737-500 was blended out of limits and is awaiting a revised Engineering repair, with a documentation gap on fastener locations that was only communicated verbally at turnover.

entities.text: blending until corrosion was fully removed

narrative_text: Wakati wa kufanya kazi kwenye bawa la kushoto la ndege ya B737-500, kutu ilipatikana juu ya ngozi ya bawa chini ya mlango wa dharura wa juu ya bawa. Idara ya Ubora na Uhandisi zilijulishwa mara moja na ripoti ikaandikwa, na Uhandisi wakaelekeza eneo hilo lisafishwe hadi kutu iondoke kabisa. Baada ya kusafisha, ilibainika eneo lililosafishwa limezidi kiwango kinachoruhusiwa, hivyo kazi imesimamishwa hadi Uhandisi watoe maelekezo mapya ya ukarabati. Kumbuka kuwa baadhi ya sehemu za bolti zilizosafishwa hazikuandikwa kwenye fomu ya matengenezo, ingawa zamu ya mchana ilielezwa kwa mdomo na msimamizi pamoja na Idara ya Ubora; tunahitaji kuboresha uandikaji wa taarifa na mawasiliano.
summary: Kutu kwenye ngozi ya bawa la ndege ya B737-500 ilisafishwa lakini eneo likazidi kiwango, na kazi imesimama ikisubiri maelekezo mapya ya ukarabati kutoka Uhandisi, huku kukiwa na pengo la uandikaji kuhusu bolti.

narrative_text: Nilikuwa nafanya kazi kwa left wing ya B737-500 nikakuta corrosion juu ya wing skin, chini ya overwing exit. Nikacall Quality Control na Engineering mara moja, wakaandika NRC, na Engineering wakasema tu-blend area hiyo mpaka corrosion iishe. Lakini baada ya kublend, ikaonekana eneo limekuwa out of limits, kwa hivyo tuko on hold mpaka Engineering warudi na revised repair. Tunahitaji pia kufungua wing tanks kwa ajili ya hiyo repair - note kwamba baadhi ya fasteners zilizoblendiwa hazikuandikwa kwenye maintenance form, ingawa dayshift walijulishwa verbally na supervisor na Quality Control. Tafadhali hakikisha hiyo detail ya fasteners inaandikwa vizuri kabla ya kuendelea.
summary: Corrosion kwenye wing skin ya B737-500 ilikuwa blended lakini eneo likaenda out of limits, sasa tunasubiri revised repair kutoka Engineering na kuna documentation gap kuhusu fasteners.

entities.text: tu-blend area hiyo mpaka corrosion iishe

narrative_text: CRJ700 came off the gate with a #1 engine hydraulic leak reported by gate mechs as the thrust reverser actuator; I logged it on the daily turnover with the RII box marked '?' since the source was unconfirmed. Inspection found the manual drive unit leaking instead, and it was robbed from another aircraft to return this one to service. Note that the manual drive unit is on the RII list — this was missed during turnover due to lateness, so please verify RII sign-off was completed before further dispatch.
summary: A CRJ700's #1 engine hydraulic leak was traced to the manual drive unit, which was replaced from another aircraft without confirming required RII inspection sign-off.

narrative_text: Ndege ya CRJ700 ilitoka geti ikiwa na tatizo la uvujaji wa hydraulic kwenye injini namba moja, ambapo mafundi wa geti walidai chanzo ni thrust reverser actuator. Niliandika taarifa hiyo kwenye kitabu cha mabadiliko ya zamu nikaweka alama ya kuuliza kwenye sehemu ya RII kwa sababu chanzo halikuwa dhahiri. Baada ya ukaguzi ilibainika kuwa manual drive unit ndiyo iliyokuwa ikivuja, na sehemu hiyo ilitolewa kutoka ndege nyingine bila kutambua kuwa manual drive unit iko kwenye orodha ya RII; hivyo inahitajika ufuatiliaji wa haraka kuhakikisha ukaguzi huo umefanyika kabla ya ndege kutumika tena.
summary: Ndege ya CRJ700 ilikuwa na uvujaji wa hydraulic uliobainika kutoka kwa manual drive unit, ambayo ilibadilishwa bila kuthibitisha ukaguzi wa lazima wa RII.

entities.text: uvujaji wa hydraulic kwenye injini namba moja

narrative_text: Ile CRJ700 ilitoka gate na discrepancy ya #1 engine hyd leak, gate mechs walisema ni thrust reverser actuator ndio inaleak. Niliandika kwa turnover book na nikaweka '?' kwa RII box kwa sababu haikuwa clear kama ni actuator kweli. Baada ya inspection wakagundua ni manual drive unit ndio ilikuwa inaleak, tukaitoa kwa ile ndege nyingine tukarudisha hii kwa service, lakini hatukurealize manual drive unit iko kwa RII list. Please someone acheck kama RII sign-off ilifanywa kabla ya kuipush tena for dispatch.
summary: CRJ700 ilikuwa na hydraulic leak iliyotokana na manual drive unit, part ambayo ilitolewa kwa aircraft nyingine bila kuconfirm RII requirement.

narrative_text: A321 work pack had 3 priority-1 items plus MEL items, including an inbound writeup for R2 cabin door indication in flight and a must-fix MEL on the cabin interphone system. We ran doors open/close and armed/disarmed each door/exit but could not duplicate the R2 door indication fault; MEL relief is available if maint control approves. Interphone MEL was cleared after ceiling panel removal and wire continuity checks, but door issue remains open pending a new plan from maint control before next flight. Fuel filter change (priority-1) still outstanding due to no filters in stock, no flight time remaining to use.
summary: Interphone MEL cleared on the A321, but R2 cabin door indication fault could not be duplicated and remains unresolved along with an outstanding fuel filter change.

narrative_text: Ndege ya A321 ilikuwa na vitu vitatu vya kipaumbele cha juu pamoja na MEL nyingine, ikiwemo tatizo la kiashiria cha mlango wa R2 lililoripotiwa wakati wa safari, na MEL ya lazima kurekebishwa kwenye mfumo wa intaphone wa kabati. Tulifungua na kufunga milango yote na kuziwasha/kuzizima lakini hatukupata tatizo lililoripotiwa la mlango wa R2; kama maint control wataruhusu, MEL inaweza kutumika kama suluhisho la muda. Tatizo la intaphone lilitatuliwa baada ya kutoa vifuniko vya juu ya kabati na kukagua nyaya, lakini tatizo la mlango bado halijafungwa na linasubiri mpango mpya kutoka maint control kabla ya safari inayofuata. Kazi ya kubadilisha vichujio vya mafuta (kipaumbele cha juu) bado haijafanyika kwa sababu havipo stoo, na muda wa ndege kutumika umeisha.
summary: MEL ya intaphone imefungwa kwenye ndege ya A321, lakini tatizo la kiashiria cha mlango wa R2 halijasuluhishwa na kazi ya vichujio vya mafuta bado inasubiri.

entities.text: kutoa vifuniko vya juu ya kabati

narrative_text: Kwa hii A321, work pack ilikuwa na priority-1 items tatu plus MEL zingine, including inbound writeup ya R2 cabin door indication wakati wa flight, na must-fix MEL kwenye cabin interphone system. Tuliopen/close milango yote na kuarm/disarm each door lakini hatukumanage kuduplicate ile door indication fault; kama maint control wataapprove, tuna option ya kuMEL hiyo item. Interphone MEL imecleared baada ya kutoa ceiling panels na kucheck wires kwa shorts/opens, lakini door issue bado open, tunasubiri new plan kutoka maint control kabla ya next flight. Fuel filter change (priority-1) bado haijafanyika kwa sababu hakuna filters stoo, na flight time ya kutumia imeisha.
summary: Interphone MEL imecleared kwenye A321 lakini R2 door indication fault haijaresolve na fuel filter change bado imeenda pending.

narrative_text: A300 had its APU replaced on night shift; the exhaust bellows connecting the APU to the exhaust duct was found deteriorated and the work card was stopped at that step, leaving remaining steps including the final inspection RII open. Maint Ops directed that the FMR log entry state the work card was not completed, though QA and the Overhaul Technician Foreman agree this is not proper given the incomplete paperwork on a major component change. Next shift must confirm status before any APU start attempt, as the aircraft routing was changed and the bellows still needs to be repaired and paperwork closed out.
summary: APU replacement on the A300 is incomplete due to a deteriorated exhaust bellows, with open work card steps and unresolved paperwork requiring follow-up before any APU start.

narrative_text: APU ya ndege ya A300 ilibadilishwa wakati wa shift ya usiku, lakini bellows ya exhaust inayounganisha APU na duct imeonekana imechakaa, na work card ilisimamishwa kwenye hatua hiyo huku hatua zilizobaki, ikiwemo final inspection RII, zikiwa bado wazi. Maint Ops walielekeza kuandikwa kwenye FMR kwamba work card haijakamilika, ingawa QA na Foreman wa Overhaul wanakubaliana kuwa hali hii si sahihi kwa sababu component kubwa imebadilishwa lakini nyaraka hazijakamilika. Shift inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha hali hiyo kabla ya kujaribu kuanzisha APU, kwani njia ya ndege ilibadilishwa na tatizo la bellows bado halijatengenezwa na nyaraka bado hazijafungwa.
summary: APU ya A300 haijakamilika kubadilishwa kutokana na bellows ya exhaust iliyochakaa, na nyaraka zake bado ziko wazi hivyo zinahitaji ufuatiliaji kabla ya kuanzisha APU.

narrative_text: Kwenye A300, APU ilibadilishwa night shift lakini exhaust bellows inayounganisha APU na exhaust duct imeonekana imechakaa, so work card ilistop kwenye hiyo step na remaining steps, including final inspection RII, ziko open. Maint Ops walisema tuweke kwenye FMR kwamba work card haikukamilika, lakini QA na Overhaul Technician Foreman wanaona hii si sawa kwa sababu ni major component replacement na paperwork bado incomplete. Next shift lazima wafollow-up status kabla ya kufanya APU start attempt yoyote, kwa sababu aircraft routing ilibadilishwa na bellows bado haijafanyiwa repair wala paperwork kufungwa.
summary: APU replacement kwenye A300 bado haijakamilika kwa sababu ya exhaust bellows iliyochakaa, na paperwork bado open hivyo inahitaji follow-up kabla ya APU start yoyote.

narrative_text: During the parking-program walk-around on the out-of-service aircraft, several discrepancies were found after more than 5 days on the ground: nose tire worn beyond limits, hydraulic leak at the steering actuator, hydraulic system B pressure module leak in the main wheel well, a dent near the trailing edge of the inboard flap, and a chafed hydraulic line at the main gear shimmy damper caused by a nearby flexible line. Crew chief has flagged that management is questioning why these were only found now; next shift should verify all findings are logged and follow up on required repairs before further work continues.
summary: Multiple discrepancies (tire, hydraulic leaks, flap dent, chafed line) found on out-of-service aircraft during walk-around, pending management follow-up.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa zunguko kwenye ndege iliyokuwa nje ya huduma, hitilafu kadhaa ziligundulika baada ya ndege kukaa chini kwa zaidi ya siku tano: tairi la mbele lilikuwa limechakaa kupita kiwango, kulikuwa na uvujaji wa maji ya haidroliki kwenye actuator ya usukani, uvujaji mwingine kwenye moduli ya shinikizo ya mfumo B wa haidroliki eneo la gurudumu kuu, bapa la ndani la flap lilikuwa na bonge karibu na ukingo wa nyuma, na bomba la haidroliki la kiondoa mtikisiko wa gurudumu kuu lilikuwa limechubuka kwa sababu ya bomba jingine laini lililokuwa karibu nalo. Kiongozi wa zamu ametaarifu kuwa uongozi unahoji kwa nini hitilafu hizi hazikugunduliwa mapema; zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuhakikisha hitilafu zote zimeandikwa vizuri na kufuatilia marekebisho yanayohitajika kabla ya kazi kuendelea.
summary: Hitilafu kadhaa (tairi, uvujaji wa haidroliki, bonge la flap, bomba lililochubuka) zilipatikana kwenye ndege iliyokuwa nje ya huduma wakati wa ukaguzi, hatua zaidi zinasubiriwa kutoka kwa uongozi.

entities.text: moduli ya shinikizo ya mfumo B wa haidroliki

narrative_text: Wakati wa walk-around ya parking program kwenye aircraft iliyo out of service, tumepata discrepancies kadhaa baada ya ndege kukaa ground kwa zaidi ya siku tano: nose tire imechakaa beyond limits, kuna hydraulic leak kwenye steering actuator, pia leak kwenye hydraulic system B pressure module karibu na main wheel well, kuna dent karibu na trailing edge ya inboard flap, na hydraulic line ya main gear shimmy damper ime-chafe kwa sababu ya flexible line iliyokuwa imewekwa karibu nayo. Crew chief ame-flag kwamba management wanauliza kwa nini haya yamegunduliwa sasa hivi tu; next shift wahakikishe findings zote zime-log vizuri na wafuatilie repairs zinazohitajika kabla ya kazi kuendelea.
summary: Discrepancies kadhaa (tire, hydraulic leaks, flap dent, chafed line) zimepatikana kwenye aircraft out of service wakati wa walk-around, follow-up inahitajika kutoka management.

narrative_text: Reassembled the R/H MLG stabilizer strut 'H' member after NDT using original hardware; both stabilizer brace pins had a small greased washer on the bolt head side and a larger washer on the nut side, and the anti-rotation tab only permitted one orientation. Installed per that orientation, torqued and safetied, then handed off the remaining install to swing shift; operational checks were not performed until day shift next day, at which point the gear failed to lock down during the alternate extension check. Please verify the washer stack-up/orientation against the maintenance manual before further gear swings, as the nut-side washer may have been installed too tight.
summary: Confusion over washer stack-up orientation during R/H MLG strut reassembly led to a gear-down lock failure discovered on the next shift's operational check.

narrative_text: Tulirudisha pamoja 'H' member ya R/H MLG stabilizer strut baada ya NDT tukitumia vifaa vya awali; pini zote mbili za stabilizer brace zilikuwa na washer ndogo yenye grisi upande wa kichwa cha bolt na washer kubwa upande wa nut, huku anti-rotation tab ikiruhusu mpangilio mmoja tu. Tulifunga kulingana na mpangilio huo, tukakaza torque na kuweka safety wire, kisha kazi iliyobaki ikakabidhiwa kwa zamu ya jioni. Ukaguzi wa uendeshaji haukufanyika mpaka zamu ya asubuhi siku iliyofuata, ambapo gear ya R/H haikufunga chini vizuri wakati wa alternate extension check. Tafadhali hakikisheni mpangilio wa washer kulingana na manual kabla ya kufanya gear swing nyingine, kwani inawezekana washer ya upande wa nut ilikazwa kupita kiasi.
summary: Mkanganyiko kuhusu mpangilio wa washer wakati wa kuunganisha upya strut ya R/H MLG ulisababisha gear kushindwa kufunga chini, hali iliyogunduliwa na zamu iliyofuata.

narrative_text: Nili-reassemble ile R/H MLG stabilizer strut 'H' member baada ya NDT nikitumia original hardware; zile pins mbili za stabilizer brace zilikuwa na washer ndogo yenye grease upande wa bolt head, na washer kubwa upande wa nut, na anti-rotation tab ilikuwa inaruhusu orientation moja tu. Ni-install kwa hiyo orientation, torque na safety wire zikafanywa, kisha nikaachia kazi iliyobaki kwa swing shift. Operational check haikufanywa mpaka day shift ya siku iliyofuata, ndipo wakagundua gear ya R/H haifungi down vizuri wakati wa alternate extension check. Tafadhali angalieni ile washer stack-up per manual kabla ya kufanya gear swing ingine, huenda ile washer ya nut side ilikazwa too tight.
summary: Kuna confusion kuhusu washer orientation wakati wa ku-reassemble R/H MLG strut, na hii ikasababisha gear kushindwa lock down, iliyogunduliwa na shift iliyofuata.

narrative_text: Beechjet 400 was placed in wheels-up configuration to troubleshoot an ADS-B fail; both proximity switch arms were disconnected but no streamer/tags were fitted due to a phone interruption with tech support. Verbal turnover to the relieving technicians focused mainly on the ADS-B/GPS antenna issue, with only a brief mention of the disconnected squat switches. Next shift must confirm both proximity switch arms are properly reconnected and streamers procedure followed before further dispatch; aircraft was released after ADS-B fail cleared but squat switch rigging was not independently verified.
summary: Incomplete handover on disconnected squat switch proximity arms during ADS-B troubleshooting on a Beechjet 400 requires follow-up verification before next dispatch.

narrative_text: Ndege ya Beechjet 400 iliwekwa katika hali ya 'wheels up' kwa ajili ya kuchunguza hitilafu ya ADS-B; proximity switch arms mbili zilifunguliwa lakini alama za onyo hazikuwekwa kwa sababu ya kuingiliwa na simu kutoka tech support. Wakati wa kukabidhi kazi kwa mafundi waliopokea zamu, mazungumzo mengi yalielekea kwenye tatizo la ADS-B na antenna ya GPS, huku kutajwa kwa kifupi tu kuhusu squat switches zilizofunguliwa. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha kuwa proximity switch arms zimeunganishwa vizuri na taratibu za alama za onyo zimezingatiwa kabla ya safari nyingine; ndege ilitolewa baada ya hitilafu ya ADS-B kuisha lakini urekebishaji wa squat switch haukuthibitishwa kwa uhakika.
summary: Kukosekana kwa taarifa kamili wakati wa kukabidhi kazi kuhusu squat switches zilizofunguliwa wakati wa uchunguzi wa ADS-B kwenye Beechjet 400 kunahitaji uthibitisho zaidi kabla ya safari inayofuata.

narrative_text: Beechjet 400 iliwekwa 'wheels up' ili tu-troubleshoot ADS-B fail; nilidisconnect zile proximity switch arms zote mbili lakini sikuweka streamer kwa sababu nilikuwa on the phone na tech support wakati huo. Wakati wa turnover kwa wale technicians walioingia, most ya conversation ilikuwa about ADS-B issue na GPS antenna, squat switches zilitajwa tu kidogo in passing. Next shift wanahitaji kuconfirm zile proximity switch arms zimereconnect properly na streamer procedure imefollowiwa kabla ya dispatch ingine, kwa sababu aircraft ilirelease baada ya ADS-B fail kuclear bila kuverify squat switch rigging.
summary: Kuna gap kwenye turnover kuhusu disconnected squat switches wakati wa ADS-B troubleshooting kwenye Beechjet 400, inahitaji follow-up verification kabla ya dispatch nyingine.

narrative_text: On the B767-300ER, crew reported the oxygen bottle pressure dropped over 200 psi during pre-departure checks, indicating the crew bottle shutoff valve was not fully open following the recent oxygen mask box replacement. Two junior technicians accessed the E/E compartment under time pressure with passengers already boarded and departure 10-20 minutes away, and confirmed by feel that the valve was open, but this was not independently verified by the lead technician given the differing feel between steel and composite bottles. Next shift must re-verify the valve position physically, review the oxygen mask box replacement task card, and ensure two-person independent confirmation is enforced for critical safety checks going forward.
summary: A crew oxygen bottle shutoff valve was not fully open after a mask box replacement, and rushed, unverified checks by junior staff under time pressure require follow-up on B767-300ER.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B767-300ER, marubani waligundua shinikizo la oksijeni limeshuka zaidi ya psi 200 wakati wa ukaguzi kabla ya safari, jambo linaloonyesha valve ya chupa ya oksijeni ya crew haikuwa imefunguliwa kikamilifu baada ya kubadilishwa kwa boksi la barakoa za oksijeni siku chache zilizopita. Mafundi wawili wapya waliingia kwenye chumba cha vifaa vya umeme (E/E compartment) chini ya shinikizo la muda huku abiria tayari wamepanda ndani na dakika 10-20 tu kubaki kabla ya kuondoka, wakathibitisha kwa kugusa tu kwamba valve ilikuwa wazi, lakini fundi kiongozi hakuthibitisha hilo mwenyewe licha ya kujua kuwa hisia ya valve hutofautiana kati ya chupa za chuma na za composite. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha tena hali halisi ya valve, kupitia upya hati ya kazi ya ubadilishaji wa boksi la oksijeni, na kuhakikisha uthibitisho wa watu wawili unafanywa kikamilifu kwa ukaguzi wa usalama muhimu.
summary: Valve ya chupa ya oksijeni ya crew haikufunguliwa kikamilifu baada ya ukarabati wa boksi la barakoa, na ukaguzi wa haraka usiothibitishwa vyema unahitaji ufuatiliaji zaidi kwenye ndege ya B767-300ER.

entities.text: chumba cha vifaa vya umeme (E/E compartment)

narrative_text: Kwa hii B767-300ER, wale pilots wame-notice pressure ya oxygen bottle imedrop na zaidi ya 200 psi wakati wa checks kabla ya departure, ikimaanisha ile crew bottle shutoff valve haikuwa fully open baada ya ile oxygen mask box kubadilishwa juzi. Wale mafundi wawili wa new guys walipanda kwa E/E compartment chini ya time pressure ikiwa pax tayari wame-board na departure ni in 10-20 minutes tu, wakaconfirm kwa feel tu kwamba valve ilikuwa open, lakini lead tech hakuverify mwenyewe ingawa anajua feel ya valve inatofautiana kati ya steel na composite bottles. Next shift wanahitaji ku-reverify valve position physically, kupitia task card ya ile mask box replacement, na kuhakikisha two-person verification inafanywa kwa hizi critical checks going forward.
summary: Crew oxygen bottle shutoff valve haikuwa fully open baada ya mask box replacement, na hizi rushed checks za mafundi wapya chini ya time pressure zinahitaji follow-up kwa B767-300ER.

narrative_text: MD-80 stabilizer trim primary drive motor was replaced after 7 hours of troubleshooting a PIREP reporting trim operating in one direction only; work was done in poor weather (high wind, snow, cold) and near shift end. Trim was checked and operated in both directions during checkout, but the part number effectivity for the newer MD-80 configuration versus the legacy motor was not verified, and the trim speed difference was not evaluated. Next shift must confirm correct part number/serial number against aircraft effectivity records and re-verify trim speed against spec before releasing the aircraft.
summary: Stabilizer trim drive motor replacement on MD-80 was completed under time and weather pressure without confirming correct part effectivity or trim speed, requiring follow-up verification.

narrative_text: Tulifanya kazi kwa masaa saba tukitatua tatizo la ndege ya MD-80 ambapo ripoti ya rubani ilionyesha stabilizer trim inafanya kazi upande mmoja tu; hatimaye motor kuu ya stabilizer trim ilibadilishwa katika hali ngumu ya hewa yenye baridi kali, upepo mkali na theluji, karibu na mwisho wa zamu. Wakati wa ukaguzi, trim ilijaribiwa pande zote mbili na ilionekana sawa, lakini hatukuthibitisha kama namba ya part inaendana na muundo mpya wa MD-80 wala kuangalia tofauti ya kasi ya trim. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha upya namba ya part na serial dhidi ya rekodi za ndege, na kupima kasi ya trim kabla ya kuruhusu ndege kuruka.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa motor ya stabilizer trim kwenye MD-80 ulifanyika chini ya shinikizo la muda na hali mbaya ya hewa bila kuthibitisha usahihi wa part, hivyo inahitaji ufuatiliaji zaidi.

narrative_text: Tuli-troubleshoot MD-80 kwa saa saba nzima kwa sababu ya PIREP ya stabilizer trim kufanya kazi one direction tu; mwisho tuka-replace ile primary drive motor, lakini weather ilikuwa mbaya sana - baridi, upepo mkali na snow, na tulikuwa tunataka kumaliza kwa haraka since ilikuwa near end of shift. Wakati wa checkout, trim ili-operate vizuri pande zote mbili, lakini hatukuchunguza kama part number ya hii motor mpya ina-match effectivity ya MD-80 hii, wala speed difference ya trim mpya. Next shift wa-verify part number na serial dhidi ya manual ya effectivity, then wa-recheck trim speed before release.
summary: Waliweka replacement drive motor kwenye MD-80 wakiwa under time pressure na weather mbaya bila kuconfirm part effectivity, so next shift lazima wa-verify.

narrative_text: A321 CDL follow-up for the right-hand #4 flap track fairing lubrication was not completed by departure station maintenance, and the AML was not updated to reflect it. The gap was only caught at shift change after the aircraft had already departed, so I contacted Maintenance at the arrival station to have the lubrication check accomplished before the next flight. Flight crew also did not catch the missing AML entry during their pre-departure review; please remind crews to verify CDL follow-up items in the AML before releasing the aircraft.
summary: An A321's required CDL flap fairing lubrication check was missed and not logged, and it was only caught after departure, requiring arrival-station maintenance to complete it before the next flight.

narrative_text: Ukaguzi wa lazima wa CDL kwa ajili ya ulainishaji wa fairing ya njia ya flap namba nne upande wa kulia kwenye ndege ya A321 haukufanyika kituo cha kuondokea, na kumbukumbu kwenye logbook ya ndege haikusasishwa. Jambo hili liligundulika tu wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, ndege ikiwa tayari imeruka, hivyo nililazimika kuwasiliana na wahandisi wa matengenezo kituo cha kutua ili kazi hiyo ikamilishwe kabla ya safari inayofuata. Wafanyakazi wa ndani ya ndege nao hawakubaini kukosekana kwa taarifa hiyo kwenye logbook kabla ya kuondoka; ni muhimu marubani wahakikishe vipengele vya CDL vimeshughulikiwa kabla ya kuruhusu ndege kuondoka.
summary: Ukaguzi wa ulainishaji wa fairing ya flap ya ndege ya A321 uliokuwa wa lazima kutokana na CDL haukufanyika wala kuandikwa, na jambo hilo liligundulika ndege ikiwa tayari imeondoka, na kulazimu kituo cha kutua kukamilisha kazi hiyo.

entities.text: fairing ya njia ya flap namba nne upande wa kulia

narrative_text: Kwa hii A321, ile CDL follow-up ya flap track fairing namba four, right-hand side, haikufanyiwa lubrication check kama required, na wa departure station hawakuweka entry yoyote kwenye AML. Niliona hii gap tu wakati wa shift change, ndege ikiwa already in the air, so nikapiga simu Maintenance huko arrival station wafanye ile check kabla ya next flight. Flight crew nao hawakucatch hiyo missing entry wakati wa review yao before departure, so tukumbushane crews wa-verify CDL items kwenye AML kabla ya kuclear ndege iondoke.
summary: A321 ilikosa lubrication check ya CDL kwa flap fairing na entry haikuwekwa kwenye AML, ikagundulika baada ya ndege kuondoka na ikabidi arrival station wa-fix before next flight.

narrative_text: B737-300 returned to gate before shift change for a takeoff warning fault; the takeoff warning test switch had failed. To gain access for the switch replacement, the tech disconnected the flight deck hydraulic brake pressure indicator cannon plug and the No. 2 oil pressure gauge cannon plug. After the switch was replaced, the cannon plugs were reconnected but appear to have been swapped, causing the brake pressure indicator circuit breaker to trip; the indicator was placed on MEL as a temporary measure. Overnight crew must verify the cannon plug connections are correctly matched and confirm the MEL can be cleared.
summary: Cannon plugs for the brake pressure indicator and No. 2 oil pressure gauge were swapped during a takeoff warning switch repair on a B737-300, tripping a circuit breaker and requiring MEL action, with overnight follow-up needed.

entities.text: hydraulic brake pressure indicator cannon plug
No. 2 oil pressure gauge cannon plug

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-300 ilirudi getini kabla ya mabadiliko ya zamu kutokana na hitilafu ya onyo la kuruka; swichi ya kupima onyo hilo ilikuwa imeharibika. Ili kupata nafasi ya kubadilisha swichi, fundi aliondoa plugs mbili za waya, moja ya kipimo cha shinikizo la breki na nyingine ya kipimo cha mafuta ya injini namba mbili. Baada ya kukamilisha ukarabati, plugs hizo zilirudishwa lakini zinaonekana zilibadilishwa mahali, jambo lililosababisha breaker ya umeme kukatika; hivyo kipimo cha shinikizo la breki kiliwekwa kwenye orodha ya MEL kwa muda. Wafanyakazi wa zamu ya usiku wanahitajika kuhakikisha waya hizo zimeunganishwa sawasawa na kufuta MEL baada ya ukaguzi.
summary: Waya za kipimo cha shinikizo la breki na kipimo cha mafuta zilibadilishwa mahali wakati wa ukarabati wa swichi ya onyo la kuruka kwenye ndege ya B737-300, na kusababisha hitilafu iliyohitaji hatua ya MEL na ufuatiliaji zaidi.

entities.text: kipimo cha mafuta ya injini namba mbili

narrative_text: B737-300 ilirudi gate kabla ya shift change kwa sababu ya takeoff warning fault; ile switch ya test ilikuwa imefail. Ili ku-access vizuri, fundi alidisconnect cannon plug ya brake pressure indicator ya flight deck pamoja na ile ya No. 2 oil pressure gauge. Baada ya kubadilisha switch, ali-reconnect plugs lakini zinaonekana zili-swap, hivyo circuit breaker ya brake pressure indicator ika-trip; iko sasa kwenye MEL kwa muda. Crew wa overnight wa-confirm cannon plugs zimeconnect sahihi kabla ya kuclear MEL.
summary: Cannon plugs za brake pressure indicator na No. 2 oil pressure gauge zilibadilishwa (swapped) wakati wa kufanya repair ya takeoff warning switch kwenye B737-300, na hii ikasababisha circuit breaker kutrip na MEL kuwekwa, hivyo overnight crew wana-follow up.

narrative_text: Heads up on the EMB-120 left elevator event flagged by the Maintenance Director: two outer hinge bolts on the vertical axis were found missing, and elevator movement in flight triggered a serious inflight emergency before a safe landing. My involvement was limited to cleaning and inspecting the hardware and confirming the washer/spacer pileup against the IPC; no bolt replacement was flagged at that time. Please follow up with QA on the bolt-torque and installation procedure for both elevator hinges, and pull the maintenance records for the last inspection cycle for review.
summary: An EMB-120 left elevator suffered a serious inflight emergency after two hinge bolts were found missing, requiring follow-up review of inspection and installation procedures.

narrative_text: Taarifa kutoka kwa Mkurugenzi wa Matengenezo kuhusu tukio la elevator ya kushoto ya ndege ya EMB-120: bolti mbili za nje za bawaba katika mhimili wa wima zilikutwa hazipo, na mwendo wa elevator ukiwa hewani ulisababisha dharura kubwa kabla ya ndege kutua salama. Kazi yangu ilikuwa ni kusafisha na kukagua vifaa hivyo tu, na kuthibitisha mpangilio wa washer na spacer kulingana na kitabu cha vipuri vya mtengenezaji; sikuona sababu ya kubadilisha bolti wakati huo. Tafadhali fuatilia na idara ya udhibiti wa ubora kuhusu utaratibu wa ufungaji wa bolti kwenye bawaba zote mbili za elevator, na pia mkague rekodi za ukaguzi wa mwisho.
summary: Elevator ya kushoto ya ndege ya EMB-120 ilisababisha dharura kubwa hewani baada ya bolti mbili za bawaba kukutwa hazipo, hivyo kunahitajika ufuatiliaji wa taratibu za ukaguzi na ufungaji.

entities.text: bolti mbili za nje za bawaba

narrative_text: Kuna update kuhusu ile EMB-120 left elevator issue ambayo Maintenance Director aliripoti: walikuta zile outer hinge bolts mbili kwa vertical axis hazipo, na movement ya elevator ikiwa in-flight ilisababisha emergency kubwa kabla ndege ku-land salama. Mimi nilikuwa naclean na kuinspect tu hizo hardware, nika-confirm ile washer/spacer pileup according to IPC, sikuona reason ya ku-replace bolts wakati huo. Tafadhali follow up na QA kuhusu bolt-torque na installation procedure ya zile hinges mbili, pia pull maintenance records za last inspection cycle for review.
summary: Kuna serious inflight emergency ilitokea kwa EMB-120 left elevator baada ya bolts mbili za hinge kukosekana, so inahitajika follow-up na QA kuhusu inspection procedures.

narrative_text: While replacing packings on the #2 engine chip detector housing, we found the tech data and packings did not match the actual parts installed. Crew Chief was called down, and on checking #1 engine chip detector we found a different valve configuration with a missing rubber seal on the #2 engine check valve; a complete valve body assembly was ordered in. Everything was reassembled and verbally passed to Lead Crew Chief that both engines require leak checks, but no log entry was made confirming this. Next shift must verify leak checks were actually performed and documented before further dispatch.
summary: Chip detector housing rework on #2 engine revealed mismatched parts and a missing check valve seal; leak checks on both engines were verbally handed over but never logged, requiring urgent verification.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kubadilisha packings kwenye housing ya chip detector ya injini namba mbili, tuligundua kuwa tech data na packings tulizopewa hazikulingana na sehemu halisi zilizokuwepo. Crew Chief aliitwa, na baada ya kuangalia chip detector ya injini namba moja, tulikuta mfumo tofauti wa valve pamoja na seal ya mpira iliyokosekana kwenye check valve ya injini namba mbili; assembly kamili ya valve body iliagizwa. Kila kitu kilirudishwa pamoja na taarifa ilitolewa kwa mdomo kwa Lead Crew Chief kuwa injini zote mbili zinahitaji leak check, lakini hakuna kiingilio chochote kilichoandikwa kwenye logbook. Zamu inayofuata lazima ithibitishe kama leak check ilifanyika na kuandikwa kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuruka tena.
summary: Ukarabati wa chip detector housing kwenye injini namba mbili ulibaini sehemu zisizolingana na seal iliyokosekana kwenye check valve, na taarifa ya leak check ilitolewa kwa mdomo tu bila kuandikwa, hivyo inahitaji uthibitisho wa haraka.

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tuna-replace packings kwa #2 ENG chip detector housing, lakini tukagundua tech data na packings hazi-match na parts halisi zilizo kwa aircraft. Tulimwita Crew Chief aje aangalie, akaenda ku-check #1 ENG chip detector, tukakuta valve configuration tofauti kabisa, na rubber seal ilikuwa imekosekana kwa #2 ENG check valve, so tuka-order full valve body assembly ije. Kila kitu kili-reassemble na turnover ilitolewa verbally tu kwa Lead Crew Chief kwamba both engines zinahitaji leak check, lakini hakuna log entry iliyofanywa. Next shift wahakikishe kama leak check ilifanyika kweli na iko documented kabla ndege haija-dispatch tena.
summary: Job ya chip detector kwa #2 ENG iligundua parts mismatch na missing seal kwa check valve, na leak check turnover ilikuwa verbal tu bila log entry, hivyo inahitaji verification ASAP.

narrative_text: Handover from graveyard shift: BE400A on gate-turn back had the Anti-Skid Control Valve union filter cleaned per M/M 32-40-00, but the aft hydraulic pressure lines to the valve were cross-connected on reinstallation despite tagging, and lead mechanic buy-back missed it. Task was job-stopped before Brake Bleeding and Anti-Skid Control Check; incoming crew must verify line routing against M/M and photos before continuing, then complete bleed and system check individually on each brake, not simultaneously.
summary: Anti-skid valve lines were mixed up during reinstallation on a Beechjet 400, and follow-up crew must verify routing before completing brake bleed and system checks.

entities.text: Brake Bleeding and Anti-Skid Control Check

narrative_text: Taarifa ya mabadiliko ya shift kutoka usiku: Ndege ya BE400A ilirudishwa geti baada ya kazi ya kusafisha kichujio cha Anti-Skid Control Valve kufanywa kwa mujibu wa M/M 32-40-00. Wakati wa kurudisha mabomba, mabomba ya shinikizo la hydraulic ya nyuma yaliunganishwa vibaya licha ya kuwa yamewekwa tag, na ukaguzi wa fundi mkuu haukugundua hitilafu hiyo. Kazi ilisimamishwa kabla ya kufanya Brake Bleeding na Anti-Skid Control Check; shift inayoingia inahitajika kuhakiki muunganiko wa mabomba kwa kutumia M/M na picha kabla ya kuendelea, kisha kufanya ukaguzi wa breki kila moja kivyake, sio kwa pamoja.
summary: Mabomba ya valve ya anti-skid yalichanganywa wakati wa kufunga tena kwenye ndege ya Beechjet 400, na shift inayofuata inahitaji kuhakiki kabla ya kukamilisha ukaguzi wa breki.

narrative_text: Handover kutoka graveyard shift: BE400A ilirudi gate-turn back baada ya kufanya cleaning ya Anti-Skid Control Valve union filter kwa mujibu wa M/M 32-40-00. Wakati wa reinstalling ya lines, aft hydraulic pressure lines kwa valve zilichanganywa hata ingawa zilikuwa tagged, na lead mechanic buy-back hakugundua issue hiyo. Task ilikuwa job-stopped kabla ya Brake Bleeding na Anti-Skid Control Check; shift inayoingia i-verify line routing kwa kutumia M/M na pictures kabla ya kuendelea, then complete the check kwa each brake individually, sio wote pamoja.
summary: Anti-skid valve lines zilichanganywa wakati wa reinstallation kwenye Beechjet 400, na incoming shift inahitaji ku-verify kabla ya kukamilisha brake checks.

narrative_text: B737 arrived from ZZZ with a known right engine exceedance light that came on during ground shutdown; the previous shift reset the light and cockpit EGT gauge box but this was never logged or passed on, so the aircraft departed and flew to IAH with the discrepancy unresolved. On arrival Maintenance Control finally directed an FMC Test on the right EEC, which returned two faults and pulled the aircraft out of service. ETR is set for today; technicians need to inspect and clean/replace the affected probe, and shift turnover procedures must be reviewed since the original write-up was dropped during handover.
summary: A B737 flew from ZZZ to IAH with an unresolved right engine exceedance fault after the issue was lost during shift turnover, and it is now out of service pending probe repair.

entities.text: inspect and clean/replace the affected probe

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737 ilifika kutoka ZZZ ikiwa na tatizo la injini ya kulia lililoonekana kama taa ya exceedance wakati ndege ilipozimwa, lakini shift iliyopita ilirudisha taa hiyo pamoja na kisanduku cha EGT bila kuandika ripoti wala kuelezea shift inayofuata, hivyo ndege ikaruka hadi IAH ikiwa na hitilafu hiyo bado haijatatuliwa. Ilipofika IAH, Maintenance Control waliagiza FMC Test ifanyike kwenye EEC ya kulia, na matokeo yalionyesha hitilafu mbili zilizosababisha ndege kutolewa nje ya matumizi. ETR imewekwa leo; mafundi wanahitajika kukagua na kusafisha au kubadilisha probe husika, na taratibu za mabadiliko ya zamu zinahitaji kupitiwa upya kwa sababu tatizo hili lilisahaulika wakati wa kuhamisha majukumu.
summary: Ndege ya B737 iliruka kutoka ZZZ hadi IAH ikiwa na hitilafu ya injini ya kulia iliyosahaulika wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, na sasa iko nje ya matumizi ikisubiri ukarabati wa probe.

entities.text: kukagua na kusafisha au kubadilisha probe

narrative_text: Hii B737 imetoka ZZZ na tatizo la right engine, exceedance light ilikuwa imewaka wakati wa shutdown lakini shift iliyopita walirudisha ile light na EGT gauge box bila kuandika kwa logbook, so ikaenda tu na deferred issue mpaka IAH. Ikifika IAH, Maintenance Control walidirect FMC Test kwenye right EEC, matokeo yakatoa faults mbili, ndio maana aircraft imekuwa out of service. ETR ni leo; technicians wanahitaji kukagua probe, either clean ama replace, na tunahitaji kuangalia hii issue ya shift turnover coz report ilisahaulika kabisa.
summary: B737 ilifly kutoka ZZZ mpaka IAH na known engine fault ambayo ilisahaulika during shift turnover, sasa iko out of service ikisubiri probe repair.

narrative_text: On B767-200, prior shift reported the #2 IDG (internal drive generator) replacement complete and asked that the feeder cable be spliced back before push to gate. In the rush to release the aircraft, I signed off airworthiness without confirming that the RII (Required Inspection Item) sign-off for the IDG change was logged, and the logbook had no such entry. Next shift please verify the RII inspection for the #2 IDG has been properly documented and independently signed before further dispatch, since this is an ETOPS aircraft requiring direct communication between shifts on RII items.
summary: A rushed handover on a B767-200 led to an unsigned RII inspection for a #2 IDG replacement, requiring urgent verification before further flight release.

narrative_text: Kwa ndege B767-200, zamu iliyopita ilieleza kuwa kubadilisha #2 IDG (jenereta ya ndani) kulikamilika na kutakiwa niunge tena feeder cable kabla ndege haijasogezwa kwenda geti. Kwa haraka ya kutaka kuiachilia ndege, nilisaini airworthiness bila kuthibitisha kama saini ya RII (Required Inspection Item) kwa mabadiliko ya IDG ilikuwa imeandikwa, na logbook haikuwa na kumbukumbu hiyo. Zamu inayofuata tafadhali hakikisheni ukaguzi wa RII kwa #2 IDG umeandikwa na kusainiwa ipasavyo kabla ya safari nyingine, kwa kuwa hii ni ndege ya ETOPS inayohitaji mawasiliano ya moja kwa moja kati ya zamu kuhusu vitu vya RII.
summary: Kupitia haraka wakati wa kubadilishana zamu kwenye ndege ya B767-200, ukaguzi wa RII kwa #2 IDG haukuandikwa, hivyo unahitaji uthibitisho wa haraka kabla ya safari nyingine.

narrative_text: Kwa hii B767-200, previous shift walisema #2 IDG replacement ilikuwa done na nikaambiwa tu ni-splice feeder cable kabla ndege haijaenda gate. Kwa sababu ya time pressure ya kuipush kwa gate, nikasign airworthiness bila kuconfirm kama RII sign-off ya ile IDG change ilikuwa imefanywa, and logbook haikuwa na entry yoyote kuhusu hilo. Next shift please mverify RII inspection ya #2 IDG imedocumented na kusainiwa properly kabla ya dispatch nyingine, since hii ni ETOPS aircraft na inahitaji direct communication kati ya shifts kwa RII items.
summary: Kwa hii B767-200, time pressure ilisababisha RII sign-off ya #2 IDG isikamilike, so next shift wanahitaji kuverify documentation kabla ya dispatch.

narrative_text: While covering as second shift crew chief on short notice, I was pulled into turnover and job assignments when ERJ 145 called in requesting a nose gear visual inspection following a towbar incident at the previous station. With no mechs free and the aircraft boarded, I went out myself, inspected the nose gear, found no abnormalities, and the captain felt no write-up was needed. Neither the crew's request nor my inspection got logged before release, so a second inspection had to be repeated later to confirm no defects. Next shift please ensure any verbal inspection requests on this tail are formally logged going forward.
summary: An undocumented nose gear inspection requested after a towbar incident led to a repeat inspection before dispatch.

narrative_text: Nilipokuwa nikisimamia kama kiongozi wa zamu ya pili kwa dharura, nilikuwa nikishughulikia makabidhiano na kugawa kazi wakati ndege ya ERJ 145 ilipoita ikiomba ukaguzi wa kuona wa gia ya pua baada ya tukio la towbar kituo kilichopita. Kwa kuwa hakuna fundi mwingine aliyekuwa huru na abiria walikuwa tayari wamepanda, nilienda mwenyewe, nikakagua gia hiyo, sikuona hitilafu yoyote, na kapteni akaona hakuna haja ya kuandika ripoti. Hata hivyo, wala ombi la wafanyakazi wa ndege wala ukaguzi wangu haukuandikwa kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka, hivyo ukaguzi ulirudiwa baadaye kuthibitisha hakuna hitilafu. Zamu inayofuata itafute kuhakikisha maombi yoyote ya ukaguzi yanaandikwa rasmi.
summary: Ukaguzi wa gia ya pua uliofanywa bila kuandikwa baada ya tukio la towbar ulisababisha ukaguzi kurudiwa kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa.

narrative_text: Nikiwa nime-cover kama second shift crew chief last minute, nilikuwa busy na turnover na kugawa jobs ndio ERJ 145 ika-call in ikiomba nose gear visual inspection baada ya towbar incident station iliyopita. Kwa sababu hakukuwa na mech ye yote free na aircraft ilikuwa already boarded, nilienda mwenyewe, nika-inspect gear, sikupata abnormalities, na captain akasema hana haja ya write-up. Issue ni kwamba request ya crew na inspection yangu hazikuwahi ku-documented before release, so ikabidi tu-repeat inspection later kuconfirm no defects. Zamu inayofuata please hakikisheni verbal requests za inspection zina-logged properly kwenye maintenance log.
summary: Nose gear inspection ilifanywa baada ya towbar incident lakini haikuandikwa, hivyo ikabidi i-repeat kabla ya dispatch.

narrative_text: Final installation inspection on the No. 9 slat (B767-300) was completed and signed off, but attention was split with another concurrent inspection task, which limited direct observation of the full install sequence. A week later the aircraft returned with a slat asymmetry fault, revealing a damaged outboard auxiliary slat track and two main slat tracks missing bushings that were not visible during the original security and operational checks. Next shift should flag this as a lesson on inspection coverage when handling parallel tasks, and review similar recent slat installations for missed hardware.
summary: A B767-300 slat installation was signed off during a period of divided attention, and a later slat asymmetry fault exposed missed track damage and missing bushings that need follow-up review.

narrative_text: Ukaguzi wa mwisho wa ufungaji wa slat namba tisa kwenye ndege ya B767-300 ulikamilishwa na kusainiwa, lakini wakati huo huo nilikuwa nikishughulikia kazi nyingine ya ukaguzi, jambo lililopunguza uwezo wa kufuatilia hatua zote za ufungaji kwa karibu. Wiki moja baadaye ndege hiyo ilirudi ikiwa na hitilafu ya usawa wa slat, ambapo ilibainika kuwa track ya nje ya slat msaidizi ilikuwa imeharibika na bushing mbili za track kuu za slat zilikuwa hazipo, mambo ambayo hayakuonekana wazi wakati wa ukaguzi wa awali. Zamu inayofuata inafaa kuangazia suala hili kama fundisho kuhusu ukamilifu wa ukaguzi wakati wa kazi zinazoendana, na kupitia upya ufungaji mwingine wa hivi karibuni wa slat kuangalia vifaa vinavyoweza kuwa vimekosekana.
summary: Ukaguzi wa ufungaji wa slat kwenye B767-300 ulifanywa wakati wa umakini uliogawanyika, na baadaye hitilafu ya usawa wa slat ilidhihirisha uharibifu na vifaa vilivyokosekana ambavyo vinahitaji ufuatiliaji.

narrative_text: Nilifanya final installation inspection ya No. 9 slat kwenye B767-300 na nikasign off, lakini wakati huo huo nilikuwa na inspection task nyingine inaendelea, so sikuwa na full attention kwa install sequence yote. Baada ya wiki moja aircraft ilirudi na slat asymmetry issue, ikaonekana kuwa outboard auxiliary slat track imeharibika na bushings mbili za main slat tracks zimekosekana, vitu ambavyo havikuonekana wazi during original security check na operational checks. Kwa shift inayofuata, tuchukue hii kama lesson kuhusu inspection coverage wakati wa parallel tasks, na tu-review installations za slat za hivi karibuni kuangalia kama kuna hardware iliyomiss.
summary: Slat installation ya B767-300 ilisign-offiwa wakati wa divided attention, na baadaye slat asymmetry fault ikaonyesha damage na missing hardware ambazo zinahitaji follow-up.

narrative_text: ERJ145 had ADC #2 replaced this shift following an unclear turnover from days; unit was R&R'd and tested per AMM, but RII inspection was missed because I was assuming an outdated bulletin exempting single-line ADC swaps from RII. Lead was asked three times for an RII-qualified tech with barometer tester experience, and the mechanic eventually sent had never operated the equipment, causing delays. Aircraft departed before the missed RII was caught; QC flagged it later that evening, and it turns out the ADC is RVSM-sensitive too, which still needs clarification. Please follow up with QC and confirm current RVSM/RII paperwork status before further dispatch.
summary: ADC #2 replacement on an ERJ145 was completed without required RII inspection due to unclear guidance, staffing/qualification gaps, and confusion over RVSM sensitivity.

narrative_text: Ndege ya ERJ145 ilikuwa na tatizo la ADC namba mbili, na tulibadilisha kifaa hicho baada ya taarifa isiyo wazi kutoka kwa zamu ya kwanza. Nilimwomba Lead mara tatu atume fundi mwenye sifa za RII na uzoefu wa kutumia kipimo cha barometer, lakini fundi aliyetumwa hakuwa na uzoefu huo, jambo lililosababisha ucheleweshaji. Baada ya kukamilisha ukaguzi wa uendeshaji na uvujaji kwa mujibu wa AMM, ndege iliondoka kabla ya mtu yeyote kugundua kuwa ukaguzi wa RII ulikosekana, na baadaye idara ya ubora (QC) iligundua kosa hilo jioni hiyo. Pia imebainika kuwa kifaa hicho kinahusiana na RVSM, jambo ambalo bado halijafafanuliwa vizuri, hivyo linahitaji ufuatiliaji wa haraka.
summary: Ukarabati wa ADC namba mbili kwenye ndege ya ERJ145 ulikamilika bila ukaguzi wa RII uliohitajika, kutokana na taarifa isiyo wazi, uhaba wa wafanyakazi wenye sifa, na mkanganyiko kuhusu RVSM.

narrative_text: Tuli-troubleshoot ADC #2 kwa hii ERJ145 baada ya turnover isiyo clear kutoka first shift, tukafanya R&R ya component na kuitest kwa mujibu wa AMM. Niliomba Lead mara tatu atume mtu mwenye RII qualification na experience na barometer tester, lakini akatuma fundi ambaye hakuwahi kutumia hiyo equipment, so ilituchukua muda. Ndege ilikuwa imeshaondoka before mtu yeyote agundue kuwa RII iliskip, na jioni yake QC wakagundua issue hiyo, ikaonekana kwamba huo ADC pia ni RVSM-sensitive, kitu ambacho bado hatujaelewa vizuri. Tafadhali follow up na QC kuconfirm status ya RII na RVSM paperwork kabla ya dispatch inayofuata.
summary: ADC #2 kwenye ERJ145 ili-R&R bila RII inspection kwa sababu ya miscommunication, staffing gap, na confusion kuhusu RVSM sensitivity.

narrative_text: B737-300 arrived with crew report of intermittent flickering DC FAIL light, initially relayed to me as #2 IRU during troubleshooting at the gate; no fault could be duplicated, so both the IRU and integrated flight accessory unit were replaced per the maintenance manual and CAT III recertification was completed satisfactorily. Logbook entry was closed against #2 IRU, but the duty line maintenance supervisor flagged before shift change that the original captain's discrepancy write-up actually named #1 IRU, not #2. I have re-contacted the mechanic who debriefed the crew to confirm which unit was actually reported faulty; incoming shift needs to verify the logbook entry matches the correct IRU and re-check paperwork/wiring diagram reference before final close-out.
summary: A logbook discrepancy over which IRU (#1 vs #2) was actually reported faulty on a B737-300 needs verification and correction before the write-up can be considered fully closed.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737-300 ilifika na taarifa kutoka kwa wafanyakazi wa ndege kuhusu taa ya DC FAIL iliyokuwa ikimulika mara kwa mara, na wakati wa ukaguzi kwenye geti tatizo lilielezwa kwangu kama la IRU namba mbili; hatukuweza kuthibitisha hitilafu hiyo tena, hivyo tulibadilisha IRU pamoja na kitengo cha integrated flight accessory unit kulingana na maelekezo ya matengenezo, na urekebishaji wa CAT III ulikamilika vizuri. Taarifa katika logbook iliandikwa ikitaja IRU namba mbili, lakini msimamizi wa matengenezo wa zamu aliniarifu kabla ya mabadiliko ya zamu kuwa taarifa ya awali ya kapteni ilitaja IRU namba moja. Nimewasiliana tena na fundi aliyezungumza na wafanyakazi wa ndege ili kuthibitisha IRU sahihi; zamu inayoingia inahitaji kuhakiki na kusahihisha taarifa hiyo kwenye logbook kabla ya kufunga suala hili kikamilifu.
summary: Kuna mkanganyiko kuhusu ni IRU gani (namba moja au mbili) iliyoripotiwa kuwa na hitilafu kwenye ndege ya B737-300, na jambo hili linahitaji kuthibitishwa na kusahihishwa kwenye logbook.

narrative_text: Tuli-receive B737-300 na crew wame-report DC FAIL light iko flickering intermittent; wakati wa troubleshooting kwa gate, niliambiwa ni #2 IRU. Hatukuweza ku-duplicate fault yoyote, so tuli-remove and replace IRU pamoja na integrated flight accessory unit kama maintenance manual inavyoeleza, tukafanya CAT III recertification na ikapass sawa. Nilikuwa nime-enter logbook entry kwa #2 IRU, lakini duty supervisor ame-flag kabla ya shift change kwamba discrepancy ya captain original iliandikwa #1 IRU, si #2. Nime-contact tena mechanic aliyeongea na crew ku-confirm which unit hasa ilikuwa faulty; shift inayoingia inahitaji ku-verify logbook entry na ku-correct kabla ya close-out ya mwisho.
summary: Kuna mix-up kuhusu IRU gani (#1 au #2) ilikuwa faulty kwenye B737-300, hivyo logbook entry inahitaji ku-verified na ku-corrected na incoming shift.

narrative_text: ERJ175 had a repeat write-up for no cool air in the cockpit during cruise, though packs worked fine on ground. CMC interrogation found two active fault codes (21000020AM2 and 21000030AM2) pointing to SPDA 2 Module 26 per the FIM, and there is no MEL deferral covering this fault. Parts were ordered but will not arrive until tomorrow; next shift signed it off as left pack deferred and released the aircraft without checking the FIM or fault codes, so this needs to be re-evaluated as non-deferrable before further flight.
summary: An ERJ175 with a non-deferrable SPDA 2 Module 26 fault was incorrectly released using a left pack deferral, requiring follow-up before next flight.

narrative_text: Ndege ya ERJ175 ina malalamiko ya kurudia kuhusu hewa baridi kutopatikana chumbani kwa marubani wakati wa safari, ingawa mifumo ya packs ilifanya kazi vizuri chini. Baada ya kuangalia kompyuta ya matengenezo, tulipata makosa mawili yanayoendelea, 21000020AM2 na 21000030AM2, yanayoonyesha tatizo kwenye SPDA 2 Module 26 kulingana na mwongozo wa FIM, na hakuna ruhusa ya kuahirisha kazi hiyo kwenye orodha ya MEL. Vipuri vimeagizwa lakini havitafika hadi kesho asubuhi; hata hivyo zamu iliyofuata iliruhusu ndege kuruka ikiwa imeandikwa kuwa pack ya kushoto imeahirishwa bila kuangalia FIM wala makosa yaliyopo. Jambo hili linahitaji kufuatiliwa haraka kwani tatizo si la kuahirishwa.
summary: Ndege ya ERJ175 iliruhusiwa kuruka kimakosa kwa tatizo la SPDA 2 Module 26 lililoandikwa kama tatizo la pack pekee, jambo linalohitaji ufuatiliaji wa haraka.

narrative_text: Kuna ERJ175 ina repeat write-up ya cool air kutokuwepo cockpit wakati wa cruise, ingawa packs zinafanya kazi poa ground. Nili-interrogate CMC nikapata two active faults, 21000020AM2 na 21000030AM2, zikielekeza SPDA 2 Module 26 kwa mujibu wa FIM, na hakuna MEL deferral ya hiyo item. Parts zimeagizwa lakini zitafika kesho asubuhi tu; but shift iliyofuata wa-sign off kama left pack deferred wakaruhusu ndege iruke bila hata ku-check FIM wala fault codes. Hii inahitaji kufuatiliwa fast kwa sababu tatizo si la ku-defer, ni non-deferrable kabisa.
summary: ERJ175 ilipewa green light kimakosa ikiwa na SPDA 2 Module 26 fault iliyowekwa kama pack deferral, inahitaji follow-up haraka.

narrative_text: B737-300 standby attitude indicator squawk was completed on night shift; phase adapter in the lower nose compartment and the P2-1 panel were reinstalled after afternoon shift had opened them up for troubleshooting. Logbook and turnover report were signed off as all items complete and ops checked. Next day pilot reported standby airspeed altimeter appears inop; corrective action was reconnecting the pitot/static lines on the indicator, so incoming shift please verify all P2-1 panel connections were properly reinstalled, especially pitot/static lines, before next dispatch.
summary: After a standby attitude indicator repair involving removal of the P2-1 panel, pitot/static lines were apparently left disconnected, causing a follow-on standby altimeter squawk that needs verification on the next shift.

narrative_text: Tatizo la standby attitude indicator kwenye B737-300 lilishughulikiwa na wafanyakazi wa zamu ya usiku, baada ya zamu ya mchana kutoa phase adapter kwenye chumba cha chini cha pua na P2-1 panel kwa ajili ya uchunguzi. Vifaa vyote vilirudishwa, na logbook pamoja na turnover report vilisainiwa kuonyesha kazi imekamilika na imefanyiwa ops check. Siku iliyofuata rubani aliripoti standby airspeed altimeter inaonekana haifanyi kazi, na ilibainika kuwa hoses za pitot/static hazikuunganishwa vizuri baada ya kufunga panel; zamu inayofuata iangalie tena muunganiko wa panel ya P2-1 kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka tena.
summary: Baada ya kutengeneza standby attitude indicator na kufungua P2-1 panel, hoses za pitot/static hazikuunganishwa vizuri, hivyo kusababisha tatizo jipya la altimeter linalohitaji ukaguzi wa haraka.

narrative_text: Ile squawk ya standby attitude indicator kwa B737-300 tuliifanyia kazi night shift, baada ya afternoon shift kuremove ile phase adapter kwenye lower nose compartment na P2-1 panel kwa ajili ya troubleshooting. Tulirudisha kila kitu, tuka-sign off logbook na turnover report kwamba job imekamilika na ime-pass ops check. Siku ya pili pilot ame-report standby airspeed altimeter inaonekana inop, na ikagundulika ati pitot/static lines hazikuwa zime-reconnect vizuri baada ya kufunga panel - kwa hivyo next shift please mrudi mcheck connections zote za P2-1 panel kabla ya next dispatch.
summary: Baada ya repair ya standby attitude indicator na kufungua P2-1 panel, pitot/static lines hazikuwa reconnected vizuri, na hii imesababisha squawk mpya ya altimeter inayohitaji follow-up haraka.

narrative_text: During R&R of the inboard right wing fuel booster pump, the slide valve retaining pin failed and the slide valve dislodged as the pump was withdrawn, causing fuel to pour out of the wing. Attempts by the two technicians to reinstall the pump and valve were unsuccessful, so the area was evacuated and leads/supervisor plus the fire department were notified immediately. Follow-up: before next removal, defuel the wing tank and inspect the slide valve retaining pin for damage/functionality prior to pulling the pump.
summary: A wing fuel pump removal led to a slide valve failure and fuel spill, requiring fire department response and a recommendation to defuel and inspect the retaining pin before future removals.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kuondoa na kubadilisha pampu ya mafuta ya bawa la kulia (inboard), pini ya kushikilia slide valve iliharibika na slide valve ikatoka nje wakati pampu ikitolewa, na hivyo mafuta yakaanza kumwagika kutoka kwenye bawa. Mafundi wawili walijaribu kurudisha pampu na valve mahali pake lakini haikufaulu, hivyo waliondoka eneo hilo na kutaarifu maleadi na msimamizi mara moja, pamoja na idara ya zimamoto. Kufuatilia: kabla ya kuondoa pampu tena, mafuta ya tangi ya bawa yanapaswa kutolewa kwanza na pini ya slide valve ikaguliwe kuhakikisha haijaharibika.
summary: Kuondolewa kwa pampu ya mafuta ya bawani kulisababisha slide valve kuharibika na mafuta kumwagika, hali iliyohitaji uingiliaji wa zimamoto na pendekezo la kukagua pini kabla ya kazi ijayo.

Sisi wawili tulijaribu ku-reinstall pump na valve lakini haikufanya kazi, so tuli-evacuate area na tukacall leads na supervisor immediately, fire department wakanotifiwa pia. Follow-up: kabla ya kuremove pump tena, lazima tu-defuel wing tank kwanza na tucheki hiyo slide valve retaining pin kama iko in good condition.
summary: Ile fuel pump removal iliisha na slide valve failure na fuel spill, ikahitaji fire department response na pendekezo la kudefuel na kucheck pin kabla ya next removal.

narrative_text: During the R outboard aft flap R&R on the B737-800, the forward attach covers on the flap support fairings were closed by other technicians without confirming the forward attach point had been torque checked after disturbance. One tech short-signed the task and left before completion, and the card was later signed off as complete following a normal flap ops check. Oncoming inspector needs to verify whether the forward fairing attach point torque was actually checked before the aircraft returns to service.
summary: Possible unverified torque check on flap support fairing forward attach point after aft flap replacement on B737-800; requires follow-up before dispatch.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kubadilisha aft flap ya R outboard kwenye B737-800, mafundi wengine walifunga vifuniko vya sehemu ya mbele ya flap support fairing bila kuthibitisha kama torque check ilifanyika baada ya kuguswa. Fundi mmoja alitia sahihi kazi bila kuikamilisha kisha akaenda zake, na kadi ya kazi ikatiwa sahihi kuwa imekamilika baada ya ukaguzi wa kawaida wa flap. Inspekta atakayeingia anahitajika kuthibitisha kama torque ya sehemu ya mbele ya fairing ilikaguliwa kabla ndege kurudi kazini.
summary: Kuna wasiwasi kuwa torque check ya sehemu ya mbele ya flap support fairing haikuthibitishwa baada ya ukarabati wa aft flap kwenye B737-800, hivyo inahitaji ufuatiliaji kabla ndege kutumika.

narrative_text: Kwenye ile R&R ya R outboard aft flap kwa B737-800, wale wengine walifunga forward attach covers za flap support fairings bila kuconfirm kama torque check ilifanyika baada ya kudisturb ile connection. Kuna fundi mmoja alishort-sign kazi akaenda zake kabla ya kukamilika, na baadaye card ikasign off as complete after normal flap ops check. Tafadhali oncoming inspector aangalie kama forward attach point ilipata torque check sahihi kabla ya aircraft kurudi service.
summary: Kuna concern kuwa torque check ya forward attach point ya flap support fairing haikuconfirm baada ya kubadilisha aft flap kwenye B737-800, so inahitaji follow-up before dispatch.

narrative_text: B737 had a fuel leak from the drip stick access on the left wing mid-section; wing was defueled to stop the leak. Attempted to remove the drip stick per the maintenance manual but found a damaged retainer screw and excessive resistance, so the panel is being opened instead to access it from behind. Crew was pulled to another job before completion; a second lead (qualified for this carrier's logbook) took over later that night, transferred fuel to the right wing to keep load below the panel, and flagged the damaged retainer screw to the lead and foreman at the start of panel removal. Follow-up needed: complete panel removal, replace damaged screw, verify drip stick reinstallation, and confirm no further leak before release.
summary: A B737 left-wing fuel leak at the drip stick required defueling and panel removal for access, with a damaged retainer screw and crew handover complicating the repair.

narrative_text: Ndege ya B737 ilikuwa na uvujaji wa mafuta kwenye eneo la drip stick, katikati ya bawa la kushoto, hivyo ilibidi kutolewa mafuta (defuel) ili kuzuia uvujaji huo usiendelee. Tulijaribu kuondoa drip stick kama inavyoelekezwa kwenye maintenance manual, lakini tuligundua screw moja ya retainer imeharibika na kulikuwa na ugumu mkubwa wa kuitoa, hivyo tuliamua kufungua panel ili kufikia sehemu ya nyuma ya stick. Kazi ilisimamishwa kwa muda kwa sababu ya majukumu mengine, na baadaye lead mwingine aliyeruhusiwa kutia sahihi logbook ya kampuni hii alichukua nafasi, akahamisha mafuta kwenda bawa la kulia ili kupunguza uzito chini ya panel, na kumjulisha lead na foreman kuhusu screw iliyoharibika kabla ya kuanza kuondoa panel. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji: kukamilisha uondoaji wa panel, kubadilisha screw iliyoharibika, na kuhakikisha drip stick imewekwa vizuri kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka.
summary: Ndege ya B737 ilikuwa na tatizo la uvujaji wa mafuta kwenye bawa la kushoto lililohitaji kutolewa mafuta na kufunguliwa kwa panel, huku screw iliyoharibika ikichelewesha ukarabati.

narrative_text: Kwa hii B737, kulikuwa na fuel leak kwa drip stick area, mid-wing kwa L side, so tuli-defuel wing hio kuzuia leak isiendelee. Tulitry kuondoa drip stick kama manual inavyosema, lakini tukapata retainer screw imeharibika na kuna resistance nyingi, so tukaamua kuopen panel ndio tupate access from the back. Job ilisimamishwa kidogo kwa sababu workload iliongezeka, na baadaye lead mwingine ambaye ame-qualify ku-sign logbook ya carrier hii akachukua job, aka-transfer fuel kwenda R wing kupunguza load chini ya panel, na aka-flag ile damaged screw kwa lead na foreman kabla ya kuanza panel removal. Follow-up inahitajika: kumaliza panel removal, kubadilisha screw iliyoharibika, na ku-verify drip stick imefit vizuri kabla ya release.
summary: B737 ilikuwa na fuel leak kwa L wing drip stick, ikahitaji defuel na panel removal, huku damaged retainer screw ikichelewesha repair na kuna handover kati ya mechanics.

narrative_text: Heads up: the ERJ-145 L/H fuel tank vent valve replacement from last shift was signed off as buy-back without QC actually witnessing the install steps, since only one of the two mechanics who did the job approached me and the turnover notes were incomplete. I had the mechanic correct his sign-off to reflect only the steps actually completed before I bought back that portion, but full traceability of who did what is still questionable. Also note a new form was opened after the wiring conduit to the vent valve was found damaged from pulling wires during install, so that repair needs inspection and closure. Please confirm with QC lead if the original buy-back paperwork needs re-review.
summary: An ERJ-145 fuel tank vent valve installation was inspected and bought back with incomplete handover documentation, and a follow-on conduit damage repair still needs inspection.

narrative_text: Taarifa: ile kazi ya kubadilisha valve ya vent ya tanki la mafuta upande wa kushoto kwenye ndege ilifanywa shift iliyopita, lakini QC hawakushuhudia hatua zote za ufungaji kwa sababu fundi mmoja tu ndiye alinijia, wakati wenzake wawili walihusika kwenye kazi hiyo, na maandishi ya turnover hayakuwa kamili. Nilimwomba fundi arekebishe sahihi yake ili ionyeshe hatua zilizokamilika tu kabla sijafanya buy-back ya sehemu hiyo, ingawa bado kuna mashaka kuhusu nani alifanya nini hasa. Pia kumbuka fomu mpya ilifunguliwa baada ya kugundulika kuwa kebo ya waya kwenda kwenye valve hiyo iliharibika wakati wa kuvuta nyaya, hivyo ukarabati huo unahitaji ukaguzi na kufungwa rasmi. Tafadhali wasiliana na kiongozi wa QC kuthibitisha kama karatasi za awali za buy-back zinahitaji kupitiwa upya.
summary: Ufungaji wa valve ya vent ya tanki la mafuta kwenye ndege ulikaguliwa na kufanyiwa buy-back huku maandishi ya turnover yakiwa hayajakamilika, na kuna ukarabati wa kebo unaosubiri ukaguzi.

Nilimfanya fundi a-correct sign-off yake iwe reflect only steps alizocomplete kabla nifanye buy-back ya hiyo portion, lakini bado kuna doubt kuhusu who did what exactly. Pia note kwamba another form imeopenwa baada ya kupata ile wiring conduit kwa vent valve imeharibika from pulling wires wakati wa install, so hiyo repair inahitaji inspection na kufungwa properly.
