summary: Ile vent valve installation ya ERJ-145 ilifanyiwa buy-back huku turnover documentation ikiwa incomplete, na kuna conduit damage repair inayosubiri inspection.

narrative_text: Rudder PCU on the B737-200 was replaced during C-check after the first unit tested faulty; MM test required disconnecting the nosewheel steering input rod, but since the nosewheel well panels were already closed and a separate job card had signed off that task, we installed the steering bypass pin instead. Rudder test and inspection signed off OK and aircraft was released, but on taxi-out the crew reported no nose steering, and it was found the steering rod was left disconnected. Turnover sheets from the prior 7-8 shifts were unclear on completed vs outstanding items - incoming shift needs to verify nosewheel steering rod reconnection status and review C-check job card cross-references before further release.
summary: A B737-200 was released to service with the nosewheel steering rod left disconnected after rudder PCU testing, due to unclear multi-shift turnover documentation.

narrative_text: Wakati wa C-check, PCU ya rudder kwenye B737-200 ilibadilishwa baada ya ile ya kwanza kuonekana na hitilafu wakati wa majaribio. Kulingana na maintenance manual, ilitakiwa kutenganisha nose steering input rod kabla ya kupima, lakini kwa sababu paneli za nosewheel well zilikuwa tayari zimefungwa na job card nyingine ilikuwa tayari imesainiwa kuonyesha kazi hiyo imekamilika, tulitumia bypass pin badala yake. Majaribio ya rudder na ukaguzi vilipita vizuri na ndege ikarudishwa kwenye huduma, lakini wakati wa taxi rubani aliripoti kutokuwepo kwa udhibiti wa steering kwa miguu, na ikagundulika kuwa ile rod ilikuwa bado imetenganishwa. Turnover sheets za zamu takriban saba hadi nane hazikuwa wazi kuhusu kazi zilizokamilika na zile zilizobaki - zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha hali ya nose steering rod na kupitia upya job cards za C-check kabla ya kuruhusu ndege kutumika tena.
summary: Ndege ya B737-200 iliruhusiwa kutumika ikiwa na nose steering rod bado imetenganishwa baada ya majaribio ya rudder PCU, kutokana na turnover sheets zisizo wazi.

narrative_text: Ile rudder PCU ya B737-200 ilibadilishwa during C-check baada ya ya kwanza ku-fail test; per maintenance manual, tulitakiwa ku-disconnect nosewheel steering input rod before testing, lakini since panels za nosewheel well zilikuwa tayari zime-close na kuna job card ingine ilikuwa already imesainiwa ikionyesha imekamilika, tuka-install bypass pin instead. Rudder test na inspection zilipita OK na aircraft ika-return to service, lakini during taxi crew waka-report hakuna nose steering, na tukagundua ile rod ilikuwa bado disconnected. Turnover sheets za shifts kama saba-nane hazikuwa clear kuhusu nini kimefanywa na nini bado open - next shift wanahitaji ku-verify status ya steering rod na ku-cross-check job cards za C-check kabla ya release nyingine.
summary: B737-200 ilirudishwa kwenye service na nose steering rod ikiwa bado disconnected baada ya rudder PCU test, kwa sababu ya turnover documentation isiyo clear.

narrative_text: During hangar moves, an A330 was towed out with only one mechanic watching the tail, since the wings appeared clear of the hangar opening; while correcting course to clear another parked aircraft, the wing swept closer to the hangar structure than expected before the mechanic waved to stop the tow. We were short-staffed with only one supertug and one qualified tow driver for the shift, and the crew lost track of the aircraft type's actual wingspan during the sequence. Next shift needs to enforce the 5-person minimum for hangar tows, no exceptions, and confirm supertug/tow-qualified staffing before any A330 moves.
summary: An A330 hangar tow proceeded with insufficient wing-watch staffing and nearly resulted in a wingtip strike due to workload and staffing shortfalls.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kuhamisha ndege kutoka hangar, ndege ya aina ya A330 ilivutwa nje huku fundi mmoja tu akiangalia mkia, kwa sababu ilidhaniwa mabawa yalikuwa hayana kizuizi chochote; lakini wakati wa kurekebisha mwelekeo ili kuepuka ndege nyingine iliyokuwa imeegeshwa, bawa lilikaribia sana muundo wa hangar kabla fundi hajaashiria kusimamisha zoezi hilo. Tulikuwa na uhaba wa wafanyakazi, tukiwa na supertug moja tu na dereva mmoja aliyehitimu kuvuta ndege, na wafanyakazi walipoteza mwelekeo kuhusu ukubwa halisi wa mabawa ya ndege hiyo. Zamu inayofuata inapaswa kuhakikisha angalau watu watano wanahusika kila mara ndege inapotolewa hangarini, bila ubaguzi, na kuthibitisha idadi ya wafanyakazi waliohitimu kabla ya kusogeza A330 nyingine yoyote.
summary: Zoezi la kuvuta ndege ya A330 kutoka hangarini lilifanywa bila wafanyakazi wa kutosha wa kuangalia mabawa, jambo lililosababisha hatari ya karibu ya mgongano.

narrative_text: Wakati wa hangar moves, tulitow out A330 na mechanic mmoja tu akiwatch mkia, kwa sababu tulidhani wings zilikuwa clear ya hangar opening; lakini tulipofanya adjustment kuepuka ndege nyingine iliyoparked karibu, wing ilikaribia sana structure ya hangar kabla mechanic hajawave kusimamisha tow. Tulikuwa short-staffed, tukiwa na supertug moja tu na tow-qualified driver mmoja tu kwa shift hiyo, so tuliforget wingspan halisi ya hiyo aircraft type. Zamu inayofuata lazima ienforce minimum ya watu five kwa hangar tows, no exceptions, na icheck supertug/tow-qualified staffing kabla ya kusonga A330 nyingine yoyote.
summary: A330 hangar tow ilifanyika bila watu wa kutosha kuwatch wings, na ikakaribia kusababisha strike kutokana na workload na staffing shortage.

narrative_text: During fuel tank entry inspection on the A319 (parked in the hangar), technicians found heavy corrosion on the attaching hardware and impact fuel panels 640CB and 640BB. Panels and hardware need to be documented and referred to engineering for repair/replacement disposition before the aircraft is released; incoming shift should confirm parts availability before proceeding.
summary: Heavy corrosion found on fuel panel attaching hardware (640CB/640BB) during tank entry inspection on A319, requiring engineering disposition before further work.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa kuingia kwenye tangi la mafuta la ndege ya A319 iliyokuwa imeegeshwa hangarini, mafundi waligundua kutu nzito kwenye vifaa vya kushikilia pamoja na paneli za mafuta 640CB na 640BB. Inahitajika hali hii iandikwe vizuri na kupelekwa kwa idara ya uhandisi ili kuamua namna ya kutengeneza au kubadilisha sehemu hizo kabla ndege haijaruhusiwa kuruka; zamu inayofuata iangalie kama vipuri vinapatikana kabla ya kuendelea na kazi.
summary: Kutu nzito imepatikana kwenye vifaa vya kushikilia paneli za mafuta 640CB na 640BB za ndege ya A319 wakati wa ukaguzi, hivyo uamuzi wa uhandisi unahitajika kabla ya kazi kuendelea.

entities.text: ukaguzi wa kuingia kwenye tangi la mafuta

narrative_text: Wakati wa fuel tank entry inspection kwa A319 iliyoko hangarini, technicians wamepata heavy corrosion kwenye attaching hardware na fuel panels 640CB na 640BB. Tafadhali document hii issue na uipeleke engineering waamue kama panels zinatakiwa kurepair au kureplace kabla aircraft haija-release; shift inayofuata i-confirm parts availability kabla ya kuendelea na job.
summary: Kuna heavy corrosion imepatikana kwenye fuel panels 640CB/640BB za A319 wakati wa inspection, so tunahitaji engineering disposition kabla ya kuendelea.

narrative_text: On the B737-700, the FMC control display unit was pulled to support another aircraft right at shift change, and the removal was never logged. A test LRU was fitted for the functional check, but the aircraft was released back to service with that test unit still installed since no spare CDU was available. Next shift needs to verify logbook entries, confirm CDU status, and swap in a proper serviceable unit before further dispatch.
summary: A B737-700 was dispatched with a test FMC display unit installed after the original removal went unlogged during a rushed shift change.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya B737-700, kitengo cha maonyesho cha FMC kiliondolewa ili kutumika kwenye ndege nyingine karibu na wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu, lakini uondoaji huo haukuandikwa kwenye logbook. Kifaa cha majaribio (test LRU) kiliwekwa kwa ajili ya ukaguzi wa utendaji, na ndege ikaruhusiwa kuendelea na safari huku kifaa hicho cha majaribio kikiwa bado kimewekwa kwa sababu hapakuwa na kipuri halisi. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuhakiki maandiko ya logbook, kuthibitisha hali ya CDU, na kubadilisha kwa kifaa sahihi kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Ndege ya B737-700 iliruhusiwa kuruka ikiwa na kifaa cha majaribio cha FMC baada ya uondoaji wa kifaa halisi kutoandikwa wakati wa mabadiliko ya zamu yenye haraka.

narrative_text: Kwa hii B737-700, ile FMC control display unit iliremove kwa ajili ya aircraft nyingine karibu na shift change, but logbook entry ya removal haikuandikwa. Walifit test LRU kwa functional check, halafu ndege ikadispatch na hiyo test unit ikiwa imebaki installed kwani hapakuwa na spare CDU. Next shift wanahitaji ku-verify logbook, confirm status ya CDU, na kubadilisha na proper unit before dispatch tena.
summary: B737-700 ilidispatch na test FMC display unit baada ya removal ya original unit kutoandikwa during shift change ya haraka.

narrative_text: Night shift spent over two hours removing the #1 engine VSV actuator on the B767-300; the MM steps did not call out three fittings (Items 9, 12, 14, Fig 401) that actually needed removal to free the actuator from its bracket, so update the job card notes for the next crew. During reinstall, the eyebolt nut was dropped and lost for a long time, delaying the task further and requiring an AOG part request from ZZZ1 since ZZZ had no stock. Supervisor pushed to move the aircraft out for an engine run due to a broken-down cleaning truck blocking the hangar, and in the rush to complete tests and leak-check the actuator, a step may have been missed — please verify all paperwork and checks were closed out before next flight.
summary: VSV actuator replacement on B767-300 ran long due to unlisted MM fittings and a lost hardware item, and rushed completion under hangar-move pressure may have left a step unverified.

narrative_text: Wafanyakazi wa zamu ya usiku walitumia zaidi ya masaa mawili wakiondoa actuator ya VSV ya injini namba moja kwenye ndege ya B767-300; maelekezo ya matengenezo hayakutaja vifaa vitatu (Items 9, 12, 14, Fig 401) ambavyo kwa hakika vilihitajika kuondolewa ili actuator itoke kwenye bracket yake, hivyo tafadhali sasisha maelezo ya kazi kwa zamu inayofuata. Wakati wa kuweka kipya, nati ya eyebolt ilidondoka na kupotea kwa muda mrefu, jambo lililochelewesha kazi zaidi na kulazimu kuombwa kipuri kutoka ZZZ1 kwa haraka kwani ZZZ hawakuwa na hicho kipuri stoo. Msimamizi alitaka ndege isogezwe nje kwa ajili ya kuwasha injini kwa sababu gari la kusafisha lilikuwa limeharibika na kuzuia hangar, hivyo kwa haraka ya kumaliza vipimo na ukaguzi wa uvujaji wa actuator, huenda hatua moja ilisahaulika — tafadhali thibitisha nyaraka na ukaguzi wote vimekamilika kabla ya safari inayofuata.
summary: Uwekaji wa actuator ya VSV kwenye B767-300 ulichukua muda mrefu kutokana na vifaa visivyotajwa kwenye maelekezo na kupotea kwa kipuri, na haraka ya kukamilisha kazi chini ya shinikizo la kuhamisha ndege huenda iliacha hatua moja bila kuthibitishwa.

entities.text: actuator ya VSV ya injini namba moja

narrative_text: Night shift tulitumia saa mbili plus tukitoa ile VSV actuator ya engine number one kwenye B767-300; MM haikutaja fittings tatu (Items 9, 12, 14, Fig 401) ambazo zilihitajika kuondolewa ili actuator i-clear kutoka kwa bracket, kwa hivyo please update job card notes kwa crew inayofuata. Wakati wa install, ile eyebolt nut ilidondoka na kupotea kwa muda mrefu, ikatuchelewesha zaidi, tukalazimika ku-order part kutoka ZZZ1 kwa AOG since ZZZ hawakuwa na stock. Supervisor alitaka aircraft i-move out for engine run kwa sababu cleaning truck ilikuwa imeharibika ikizuia hangar, so tulikuwa tuna-rush kumaliza tests na leak check ya actuator — kuna step ambayo huenda ilisahaulika, so please verify paperwork na checks zote zime-close before next flight.
summary: VSV actuator job kwenye B767-300 ilichukua muda mrefu because ya fittings zisizotajwa kwenye MM na kupotea kwa hardware, halafu rush ya ku-clear hangar space huenda iliacha step moja bila kucheki.

entities.text: VSV actuator ya engine number one

narrative_text: During today's cycle count in the hazmat storage area, a dangerous goods discrepancy was found for part XX-XXXX-X-XXX; it was packed inside the same box as XX-XXXX-X-XXY and was not identified as hazmat at the time of counting. The item was counted without recognizing its hazmat status, likely due to workload and time pressure on shift. Next shift please verify hazmat labeling on all boxed items in that bin and re-confirm the cycle count records before releasing the discrepancy report.
summary: A hazmat item was miscounted during cycle count because it was co-boxed with another part and not flagged as dangerous goods, requiring follow-up verification.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kufanya hesabu ya mzunguko (cycle count) leo, kulibainika tofauti ya bidhaa hatari kwa sehemu XX-XXXX-X-XXX, ambayo ilikuwa imewekwa kwenye sanduku moja na XX-XXXX-X-XXY na haikutambuliwa kama hazmat wakati wa kuhesabu. Kipengele hiki kilihesabiwa bila kujua kuwa ni bidhaa hatari, huenda kutokana na mzigo mkubwa wa kazi na muda mfupi wa zamu. Zamu inayofuata tafadhali kaguni lebo za hazmat kwenye masanduku yote eneo hilo na muhakikishe rekodi za hesabu kabla ya kuwasilisha ripoti ya tofauti hiyo.
summary: Bidhaa hatari haikutambuliwa wakati wa hesabu ya mzunguko kwa sababu ilikuwa imewekwa pamoja na sehemu nyingine kwenye sanduku moja, hivyo inahitaji ukaguzi zaidi.

narrative_text: Leo wakati wa cycle count, kulikuwa na dangerous goods discrepancy kwa part XX-XXXX-X-XXX, ilikuwa imewekwa ndani ya box moja na XX-XXXX-X-XXY na hakuna aliyejua ni hazmat wakati wa kuhesabu. Item ilicount bila kutambua status yake ya hazmat, labda ni kwa sababu ya workload na time pressure ya hiyo shift. Next shift please mkague hazmat labels kwa boxes zote pale storage area na muconfirm cycle count records kabla ya kusubmit hiyo discrepancy report.
summary: Part ya hazmat ilikosewa kutambuliwa during cycle count kwa sababu ilikuwa imewekwa pamoja na part nyingine kwenye box moja, hivyo inahitaji follow-up verification.

narrative_text: During the tow of two B737-900 aircraft into the hangar tonight, I noticed the right ram air door on both aircraft was soft/deflected when pushed, consistent with the known Fleet Engineering Directive issue on these doors. I confirmed no open log pages existed for either aircraft, so I wrote up both discrepancies before returning to my assigned task on the EEC install. Next shift should verify both write-ups have been actioned by maintenance control and confirm parts/inspection follow-up on the ram air doors.
summary: Technician found and logged suspect ram air door discrepancies on two B737-900 aircraft during a hangar move; follow-up on write-up action is needed.

narrative_text: Wakati wa kuvuta ndege mbili za aina ya B737-900 kuingiza hangarini usiku wa leo, niligundua kuwa mlango wa right ram air kwenye ndege zote mbili ulikuwa laini/unaingia ndani nilipoubonyeza, jambo linalofanana na tatizo linalojulikana kwenye Fleet Engineering Directive. Nilihakikisha hakuna log page iliyofunguliwa kwa ndege hizo mbili, hivyo niliandika ripoti za matatizo hayo kabla ya kurudi kwenye kazi yangu ya kufunga EEC. Shift inayofuata inapaswa kuthibitisha kama ripoti hizo zimeshughulikiwa na maintenance control na kufuatilia ukaguzi wa milango hiyo.
summary: Fundi aligundua na kuripoti hitilafu za mlango wa ram air kwenye ndege mbili za B737-900 wakati wa kuzihamishia hangarini, na ufuatiliaji unahitajika.

narrative_text: Wakati tuna-tow zile ndege mbili za B737-900 kuingiza hangar usiku wa leo, niliobserve kwamba right ram air door kwa zote mbili ilikuwa inaingia ndani nikiipush, sawa na ile issue ya Fleet Engineering Directive tumekuwa tukiiona sana. Nilicheck kwenye system kama kuna open log page, na kuona hakuna, so niliandika write-up za zote mbili kabla ya kurudi kwa task yangu ya ku-install EEC. Shift inayofuata iconfirm kama write-ups zimeactioned na maintenance control, na ifuatilie inspection ya hizo ram air doors.
summary: Technician alifind na kulog ram air door discrepancies kwenye ndege mbili za B737-900 wakati wa hangar move, na follow-up inahitajika.

narrative_text: Forward cargo bay stringer repair on the B737-200 was passed across three shifts and the fabricated parts (trimmed, drilled, alodined and primed) were partly installed before anyone caught that no inspector signoffs existed for damage removal, treat-and-prime, or part fabrication. The mechanic who started the install said he was following what he'd been taught in new-hire training, which suggests a gap in how paperwork procedures are being conveyed to new technicians. Repair had to be removed, parts cleaned up, and damage-removal signoff obtained before work can resume; next shift please confirm all buyback/inspection stamps are in place before continuing installation.
summary: A multi-shift stringer repair on a B737-200 was partially installed without required inspector signoffs due to time pressure and unclear paperwork training, requiring removal and rework.

narrative_text: Ukarabati wa stringer kwenye forward cargo bay ya ndege ya B737-200 ulipitia zamu tatu za wafanyakazi, na vipande vilivyotengenezwa (kukatwa, kuchimbwa matundu, kupakwa alodine na primer) vilianza kufungwa kabla ya mtu yeyote kugundua kuwa hakuna sahihi za ukaguzi kwa ajili ya kuondoa uharibifu, matibabu na kupaka rangi ya kwanza, au utengenezaji wa vipande. Fundi aliyeanza ufungaji alisema alifundishwa hivyo wakati wa mafunzo ya wafanyakazi wapya, jambo linaloonyesha kuna tatizo katika jinsi taratibu za makaratasi zinavyofundishwa. Ukarabati ulibidi uondolewe, vipande visafishwe, na sahihi ya kuondoa uharibifu ipatikane kabla ya kazi kuendelea; zamu ijayo tafadhali thibitisha muhuri zote za ukaguzi zipo kabla ya kuendelea na ufungaji.
summary: Ukarabati wa stringer kwenye B737-200 uliofanywa na zamu kadhaa ulifungwa kiasi bila sahihi za ukaguzi zinazohitajika kwa sababu ya haraka na mafunzo yasiyo wazi ya makaratasi, hivyo ilibidi uondolewe na kurekebishwa.

entities.text: matibabu na kupaka rangi ya kwanza

narrative_text: Kwa hii stringer repair ya forward cargo bay kwa B737-200, imepitia mpaka zamu tatu, na yule mechanic wa turnover aliweza trim na drill zile parts, akazi-alodine na kuzi-prime, halafu akaanza install bila kupata inspector signoff kabisa - hakuna signoff ya damage removal wala treat and prime, hata fabrication ya parts haina buyback. Yule mtu wa turnover alisema huyo ndio alifundishwa hivyo kwenye new-hire training, so kuna gap kwa jinsi paperwork procedures zinafundishwa kwa mechanics wapya. Tulilazimika kuremove ile repair, tuclean up parts, na tupate damage removal signoff kabla ya kuendelea; next shift please confirm hizo inspection stamps zote ziko in place kabla ya kuinstall tena.
summary: Stringer repair ya B737-200 iliinstall kiasi na zamu tofauti bila inspector signoffs muhimu, kwa sababu ya time pressure na mafunzo yasiyo clear ya paperwork, hivyo ikabidi iremove na kufanywa upya.

narrative_text: While completing a task handed over from another technician on the B767-300ER turbine rear frame, I installed a ring seal that is not part of this engine's configuration; the paperwork I was following referenced the wrong manual section, and I mistook the seal shown in the illustrated parts catalog attached to the new parts box. Day shift found the open ring seal package I left behind and traced it back to the install, confirming the error with me directly. Aircraft has been located and the incorrect ring seal removed, but please verify the correct seal and hardware are installed per the right IPC reference before further sign-off.
summary: A technician mistakenly installed a non-configuration ring seal on a B767 turbine rear frame due to incorrect manual reference and unfamiliarity with the task; the aircraft was located and the seal removed, pending final verification.

narrative_text: Nikimaliza kazi niliyoachiwa na fundi mwenzangu kwenye turbine rear frame ya ndege ya B767-300ER, nilifunga ring seal ambayo si sehemu ya usanidi wa injini hiyo, kwani karatasi za kazi nilizotumia zilikuwa na rejea isiyo sahihi ya manual, na nilidhani niliona seal hiyo kwenye illustrated parts catalog iliyokuwa imebandikwa kwenye boksi la spea mpya. Zamu ya mchana waligundua kifurushi wazi nilichoacha cha ring seal na kufuatilia hadi kwenye ufungaji huo, na walithibitisha nami kuhusu tatizo hilo. Ndege imepatikana na seal isiyo sahihi imeondolewa, lakini ni muhimu kuthibitisha kuwa seal na vifaa sahihi vimefungwa kulingana na rejea sahihi ya IPC kabla ya kukamilisha kazi.
summary: Fundi alifunga ring seal isiyo sahihi kwenye turbine rear frame ya ndege ya B767 kwa sababu ya rejea potofu ya manual na uzoefu mdogo; ndege imepatikana na seal imeondolewa, ikisubiri uthibitisho wa mwisho.

narrative_text: Nilikuwa nina-complete job ya technician mwenzangu kwenye turbine rear frame ya B767-300ER, na niliinstall ring seal ambayo si part ya configuration ya hio engine. Paperwork niliyokuwa nikitumia ilikuwa na wrong manual reference, na nikafikiri niliona hio seal kwenye illustrated parts catalog iliyokuwa attached kwenye box ya parts mpya. Day shift walipata open package niliyoacha ya ring seal, wakafuatilia mpaka kwa install na kuconfirm na mimi. Aircraft imepatikana na seal imeremovwa, lakini tunahitaji ku-verify kwamba correct seal na hardware zimefungwa according to sahihi IPC reference kabla ya kufunga job hii.
summary: Technician aliinstall wrong ring seal kwenye B767 turbine rear frame kwa sababu ya manual reference isiyo sahihi na inexperience; aircraft imepatikana, seal imeremovwa, but verification bado inahitajika.

narrative_text: During overnight borescope inspection on #2 engine, 3rd shift completed the job and reinstalled all borescope plugs and igniters that were bagged and tagged by 2nd shift. One plug near the 10 o'clock position, at eye level, was not bagged or tagged and was missed during reinstallation since it was not verified against the job card which ports 2nd shift had actually removed. Next shift/QA needs to confirm all borescope plugs on #2 engine are accounted for and installed before further engine run or dispatch. Recommend job card be updated to require streamers/tags on all removed plugs and improved shift-to-shift verification at the aircraft.
summary: A borescope plug on #2 engine was left uninstalled overnight because it was not tagged like the others, and the outgoing shift did not verify all removed ports against the job card.

narrative_text: Wakati wa ukaguzi wa borescope kwenye injini namba 2 usiku, zamu ya tatu ilimaliza kazi na kurudisha plugs na igniters zote zilizowekwa kwenye mfuko na lebo na zamu ya pili. Plug moja karibu na nafasi ya saa kumi, iliyokuwa karibu na usawa wa jicho, haikuwa na mfuko wala lebo hivyo ikasahaulika kurudishwa kwa sababu hatukuthibitisha kwenye job card ni ports zipi hasa zilizotolewa na zamu iliyotangulia. Zamu inayofuata na idara ya ubora wanahitajika kuhakikisha plugs zote za borescope kwenye injini namba 2 zimewekwa vizuri kabla ya kuendesha injini au ndege kutumika tena. Pia inashauriwa job card iongezwe kipengele cha kuweka alama au vitambulisho vinavyoonekana wazi kwenye plugs zote zinazotolewa, na mawasiliano kati ya zamu ziboreshwe kwenye ndege.
summary: Plug moja ya borescope kwenye injini namba 2 ilisahaulika kurudishwa usiku kwa sababu haikuwa na lebo kama zingine, na zamu iliyoondoka haikuthibitisha ports zote zilizotolewa dhidi ya job card.

narrative_text: Jana usiku tulikuwa tunafanya borescope inspection kwenye #2 engine, na 3rd shift ndio walimaliza job baada ya 2nd shift kuanza na ku-remove borescope ports. Tulirudisha plugs na igniters zote zilizokuwa bagged and tagged, lakini kuna plug moja karibu na 10 o'clock position, level na jicho, ambayo haikuwa na bag wala tag so tukaikosa kabisa. Tatizo ni kwamba hatukuverify na job card ports zipi hasa zilizokuwa removed na previous shift, tulitegemea tu zile zilizokuwa bagged. Next shift na QA wanahitaji ku-confirm plugs zote za #2 engine ziko installed kabla ya engine run, na tunapendekeza job card iwe na streamers kwa hardware zote plus overlap nzuri zaidi kati ya shifts.
summary: Plug moja ya borescope kwenye #2 engine ilikosekana kuinstall kwa sababu haikuwa tagged, na kulikuwa na communication breakdown kati ya shifts kuhusu ports zilizo removed.

narrative_text: B757-200 nose gear steering valve job (from the July pressurization air turn-back) was handed over mid-task, with the steering valve cover panel already partially removed by the previous shift. Incoming tech completed the panel removal, found and fixed a sticking towing bypass lever (seals replaced, leak/ops check good), then reinstalled that cover and signed off the write-up. It was later realized the panel actually referenced in the write-up is a separate one on the forward left side of the nosewheel well, not the one that was closed out - no maintenance manual reference was available to confirm panel location at the time. Next shift needs to verify which panel corresponds to the open write-up item and confirm proper closure, referencing the maintenance manual for exact panel location before sign-off.
summary: A technician mistakenly signed off the wrong nose gear steering valve panel on a B757-200 due to lack of clear maintenance manual location reference, leaving the actual write-up panel in the nosewheel well unconfirmed.

entities.text: forward left side of the nosewheel well

narrative_text: Kazi ya kubadilisha steering valve ya nose gear kwenye ndege B757-200, iliyotokana na tukio la kurudi hewani mwezi Julai kwa sababu ya kushindwa kubana hewa, ilikutwa ikiendelea kutoka shift iliyopita, huku kifuniko cha steering valve kikiwa kimeanza kuondolewa. Fundi aliyeingia zamu aliendelea kuondoa kifuniko hicho, akagundua towing bypass lever ilikuwa inakwama, na pamoja na fundi mwenzake wakabadilisha seals na kufanya ukaguzi wa uvujaji ambao ulionyesha hali nzuri, kisha wakarudisha kifuniko na kusaini kazi kama imekamilika. Baadaye ilibainika kuwa panel iliyotajwa kwenye write-up halisi iko upande wa mbele kushoto wa nosewheel well, tofauti na ile iliyofungwa - hakukuwa na rejea ya maintenance manual kuonyesha eneo sahihi la panel hiyo wakati huo. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuthibitisha ni panel gani hasa inayohusika na write-up, na kuhakikisha imefungwa ipasavyo kwa kutumia maintenance manual kuonyesha eneo kamili kabla ya kusaini.
summary: Fundi alisaini kwa makosa panel isiyo sahihi ya steering valve ya nose gear kwenye B757-200 kutokana na kukosekana kwa rejea wazi ya eneo la panel, na hivyo kuacha panel halisi iliyoandikwa kwenye write-up ikiwa haijathibitishwa.

narrative_text: Ile job ya ku-change nose gear steering valve kwa B757-200, ambayo ilitokana na ile air turn-back ya July kwa sababu ndege ilishindwa ku-pressurize, nilikuta imeshaanzishwa na previous shift, panel ya steering valve cover ikiwa imeanza kutolewa. Nikamalizia kutoa ile cover, nikagundua towing bypass lever inasticking, so mimi na AMT mwenzangu tuka-replace seals na ku-do leak check, ikaonyesha ok. Nikarudisha ile panel na ku-sign off write-up, lakini baadaye ikagundulika kwamba panel halisi iliyoandikwa kwenye write-up iko forward left side ya nosewheel well, si ile niliyofunga - hapakuwa na maintenance manual reference ya kuonyesha location ya hiyo panel. Next shift lazima wa-confirm ni panel gani hasa inahusiana na open write-up item na wa-verify imefungwa properly, wakiangalia maintenance manual kwa exact location kabla ya kusign off.
summary: Fundi alisign off panel mbaya ya nose gear steering valve kwa B757-200 kwa sababu hakukuwa na clear reference ya location kwenye maintenance manual, hivyo ile actual panel iliyo kwenye write-up bado haijaconfirm.

narrative_text: B757-200 engine IDG was replaced on the previous shift; turnover stated only the chip detectors still needed checking and all other work was complete. Oncoming lead technician relied on this verbal handover and did not call out the RII inspection for the IDG installation before assigning the mechanic to the next check item. RII was later accomplished at another station with no flight discrepancies, but logbook review flagged the missed call-out; recommend verifying RII status directly against the logbook, not verbal turnover, before further assignments.
summary: A verbal shift turnover on a B757-200 IDG replacement omitted the required RII call-out, which was only caught later during logbook review.

narrative_text: IDG ya B757-200 ilibadilishwa zamu iliyopita, na taarifa ya makabidhiano ilieleza kuwa ni chip detectors tu zilizobaki kukaguliwa, kazi nyingine zote zikiwa zimekamilika. Fundi mkuu wa zamu inayofuata alitegemea taarifa hiyo ya mdomo na hakuita ukaguzi wa RII uliohitajika kwa ufungaji wa IDG kabla ya kumpangia fundi kazi ya ukaguzi uliobaki. Ukaguzi wa RII ulifanywa baadaye kituo kingine bila tatizo lolote la ndege, lakini ukaguzi wa logbook ulibaini kosa hilo la kutoita RII; inashauriwa kuthibitisha hali ya RII kupitia logbook moja kwa moja, si kwa taarifa ya mdomo tu.
summary: Makabidhiano ya mdomo kuhusu ubadilishaji wa IDG kwenye B757-200 yalisababisha kukosekana kwa ukaguzi wa RII, jambo lililobainika baadaye kwenye ukaguzi wa logbook.

narrative_text: Kwenye B757-200, engine IDG ilibadilishwa zamu iliyopita, na handover ilisema chip detectors ndio pekee zilizobaki ku-check, kazi zingine zote zimekamilika. Lead tech wa oncoming shift alitegemea hiyo verbal turnover pekee na hakufanya call-out ya RII inspection ya IDG install kabla ya ku-assign mechanic kwenye check item nyingine. RII ilifanywa later kwenye station tofauti, hakuna flight discrepancies, lakini logbook review ilibaini kwamba call-out ilikosekana; tafadhali future assignments zi-confirm RII status straight kwenye logbook, si kwa word of mouth tu.
summary: Verbal handover ya IDG replacement kwenye B757-200 ilisababisha kukosekana kwa RII call-out, iliyogunduliwa later kwenye logbook review.

narrative_text: On the A300, we carried out a nose landing gear swing after night shift replaced the shock absorber, and both of us signed off the task without flagging it as an RII. GPM requires RII sign-off whenever a component or actuator affecting extension, retraction or locking is installed or rigged, and we did not realize the shock absorber falls under that category. Please have QA review the paperwork and confirm whether a proper RII inspection needs to be completed before further dispatch.
summary: Nose gear swing on the A300 was signed off without recognizing the shock absorber replacement required an RII inspection, needing QA follow-up.

narrative_text: Kwenye ndege ya A300, tulifanya ukaguzi wa mwendo wa gia ya mbele baada ya wafanyakazi wa zamu ya usiku kubadilisha shock absorber, na wote wawili tulisaini kazi hiyo bila kutambua kuwa ilihitaji ukaguzi wa RII. Kitabu cha GPM kinaeleza kuwa RII inahitajika pale sehemu au kifaa kinachohusika na kutanda, kurudisha, au kufunga gia kinapowekwa au kurekebishwa, na hatukufahamu kuwa shock absorber inahusika na hilo. Tunahitaji timu ya udhibiti wa ubora kupitia nyaraka hizo na kuthibitisha kama ukaguzi kamili wa RII unahitajika kabla ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka tena.
summary: Ukaguzi wa gia ya mbele ya ndege ya A300 ulisainiwa bila kutambua kuwa ulihitaji ukaguzi wa RII baada ya kubadilishwa kwa shock absorber.

entities.text: ukaguzi wa mwendo wa gia ya mbele

narrative_text: Kwa hii A300, tulido nose gear swing baada ya night shift kubadilisha shock absorber, tukasign off the item bila kugundua kwamba ilikuwa RII item. GPM inasay RII inahitajika whenever component au actuator inayoaffect extension, retraction ama locking imeinstall au kurigwa, na sisi hatukuconsider shock absorber kama inaaffect hizo functions. Tunahitaji QA wapitie hii paperwork na waconfirm kama proper RII inspection inahitajika kabla ndege irelease for dispatch.
summary: Nose gear swing ya A300 ilisign off bila kutambua ni RII item baada ya shock absorber kubadilishwa, so QA wanahitajika kufollow up.

narrative_text: Opened the #1 engine cowl and thrust reverser on the MD-11 at the gate to hand over to hangar crew for the #1 engine IDG R&R. Due to workload from covering multiple gates that night, I turned the job over to the hangar mechanics without pulling and collaring the circuit breakers per AMM 71-10-00-2-1. Incoming crew/hangar team must verify breaker status before continuing work, and this needs to be flagged given the manpower shortage that night. Recommend anyone assigned an OTS aircraft be relieved of other gate duties to prevent this kind of miss.
summary: Technician failed to pull and collar circuit breakers before handing over an MD-11 #1 engine IDG R&R to hangar crew due to workload from covering multiple gates.

narrative_text: Nilifungua cowl na thrust reverser ya engine namba 1 kwenye ndege ya MD-11 gate ili kuikabidhi kwa wafanyakazi wa hangar kwa ajili ya kuondoa na kubadilisha IDG ya engine namba 1. Kwa sababu ya shughuli nyingi usiku huo nikizunguka gate mbalimbali, nilikabidhi kazi hiyo kwa mafundi wa hangar bila kuvuta na kufunga circuit breakers kama inavyotakiwa na AMM 71-10-00-2-1. Timu inayoendelea na kazi inahitajika kuthibitisha hali ya circuit breakers kabla ya kuendelea, na suala hili liangaliwe kwa uzito kutokana na uhaba wa wafanyakazi usiku huo. Napendekeza mtu anayeshughulikia ndege iliyo OTS asipangiwe gate nyingine ili kuepuka makosa kama haya.
summary: Fundi alisahau kuvuta na kufunga circuit breakers kabla ya kukabidhi kazi ya IDG ya engine namba 1 ya MD-11 kwa wafanyakazi wa hangar, kutokana na shughuli nyingi za gate nyingi usiku huo.

narrative_text: Nilifungua ile #1 engine cowl na thrust reverser kwenye MD-11 pale gate, ku-turnover kwa hangar crew wafanye R&R ya #1 engine IDG. Nilikuwa nazunguka gates zingine hiyo usiku, so nikiwapa turnover hangar mechanics nikaforget kupull na kucollar circuit breakers kama AMM 71-10-00-2-1 inavyosema. Whoever anacontinue na job hii lazima acheck circuit breaker status kabla ya kuendelea, tunayo staffing shortage hiyo night ndio maana things zikawa hectic. Nadhani ukiassign mtu OTS aircraft, apewe break kutoka gates zingine ili asimiss vitu kama hivi.
summary: Fundi alimiss kupull na kucollar circuit breakers before turnover ya #1 engine IDG R&R kwenye MD-11, kwa sababu ya workload ya kuzunguka gates nyingi hiyo usiku.

narrative_text: On Aircraft X, both flight deck escape rope compartments were found open prior to departure, with the ropes hanging loose. Technicians discovered that neither rope was actually attached to the airframe, and both were missing cotter pins on the anchor plates, meaning neither would have functioned in an emergency. Next shift please review the task cards for dual maintenance on escape ropes and confirm correct installation on any aircraft that went through the same work package.
summary: Both flight deck escape ropes on Aircraft X were found unattached and missing cotter pins, rendering them unusable in an emergency, requiring a review of related maintenance task cards.

entities.text: task cards for dual maintenance on escape ropes

narrative_text: Kwenye Ndege X, sehemu zote mbili za kuhifadhi kamba za kutorokea dharura kwenye chumba cha marubani zilipatikana zikiwa wazi kabla ya safari kuanza, huku kamba zikining'inia bila kufungwa. Mafundi walibaini kuwa kamba hizo hazikuwa zimeunganishwa kwenye mwili wa ndege, na pini za nondo (cotter pins) hazikuwepo kwenye vibao vya nanga, hali iliyomaanisha kuwa kamba hizo zisingeweza kutumika endapo dharura ingetokea. Zamu inayofuata iangalie tena kadi za kazi za matengenezo yanayohusisha watu wawili kwa kamba za dharura na kuhakikisha ufungaji sahihi kwenye ndege nyingine zilizofanyiwa kazi sawa.
summary: Kamba mbili za kutorokea dharura kwenye Ndege X zilipatikana hazijafungwa vizuri na hazina pini za nondo, hali iliyozifanya zisiweze kutumika dharura ikitokea, hivyo kadi za kazi zinahitaji kukaguliwa upya.

entities.text: sehemu zote mbili za kuhifadhi kamba za kutorokea dharura
kadi za kazi za matengenezo yanayohusisha watu wawili

narrative_text: Kwa Aircraft X, zile escape rope compartments mbili za flight deck zilipatikana zi-open before departure, kamba zikiwa zinadangling tu. Technicians walikuja kukuta kwamba ropes hazikuwa attached kwenye airframe, na cotter pins hazikuwepo kwenye anchor plates, so hizo ropes zisingeweza kufanya kazi in case ya emergency. Shift inayofuata i-review zile task cards za dual maintenance kwa escape ropes na icheki kama installation iko sawa kwenye ndege zingine zilizopitia hiyo hiyo work package.
summary: Escape ropes mbili za Aircraft X zilipatikana hazija-attach na hazina cotter pins, so haziwezi kufanya kazi emergency ikitokea, hivyo task cards zinahitaji ku-reviewiwa.

narrative_text: Job card for the B737-300 spoiler and brake hydraulic line replacement on right and left wings was signed off as complete by the lead based on mech stamps, but the attached carry-over page had an inspection step overlooked and the top right wing panel was never secured after installation. The panel and its hydraulic lines separated in flight right after takeoff, causing hydraulic loss and a return to gate. Job card only covers panel removal, not reinstallation/inspection, so please flag this gap for the next shift and confirm the card has been revised before further use.
summary: A wing panel left unsecured due to a job-card gap and missed shift turnover caused an in-flight hydraulic line failure shortly after takeoff.

entities.text: spoiler and brake hydraulic line replacement

narrative_text: Job card ya kubadilisha spoiler na hydraulic lines za brake kwenye mbawa za kulia na kushoto za B737-300 ilisainiwa na lead kama kazi imekamilika, kwa sababu blocks zote za mech zilikuwa zimepigwa stamp. Hata hivyo, ukurasa wa turnover uliyowekwa pamoja na job card ulikuwa na hatua ya ukaguzi iliyosahaulika, na panel ya juu ya mbawa ya kulia haikufungwa vizuri baada ya kufungwa. Panel hiyo pamoja na hydraline zake zilitoka wakati wa ndege muda mfupi baada ya kuruka, na kusababisha upotevu wa hydraulics na ndege kurudi getini. Ni muhimu shift inayofuata iangalie kama job card imesahihishwa ili kuhakikisha hatua ya kufunga panel na ukaguzi inajumuishwa.
summary: Panel ya mbawa haikufungwa vizuri kwa sababu ya pengo katika job card na turnover, na hili lilisababisha tatizo la hydraulics baada ya kuondoka.

narrative_text: Ile job card ya spoiler na brake hyd lines replacement kwa right na left wing ya B737-300 ilisign-offiwa na lead kama complete, kwa sababu blocks zote za mech zilikuwa zime-stamp. Lakini kwenye ile carry-over page, kuna inspection step ambayo ilisahaulika, na ile top right wing panel haikusecure vizuri baada ya installation. Panel na hydraulic lines zake zilitoka in-flight muda mfupi baada ya takeoff, causing hydraulic loss na aircraft ikarudi gate. Job card haina block ya ku-install panel back, ni removal tu iko documented, kwa hivyo next shift wahakikishe kama job card imefanyiwa revision.
summary: Job card haikuwa na step ya ku-reinstall panel, hivyo ile top right wing panel ilibaki loose na ikasababisha hydraulic failure baada ya takeoff.

narrative_text: During #11 slat adjustment, the outboard target on the auxiliary track appeared misaligned with its sensor, so we swapped target positions without confirming against the AMM. Under time pressure to release the aircraft and rushing paperwork before the 2nd shift inspector's stamp, the swap was never documented, and subsequent sensor gap and PSEU/FSEU checks all passed without catching it. Next shift needs to re-verify target installation against the AMM before signing off any further adjustment steps.
summary: An undocumented, unverified target swap during slat adjustment was masked by passing electrical checks and needs re-verification next shift.

narrative_text: Wakati wa marekebisho ya slat namba 11, target ya nje kwenye auxiliary track ilionekana haikupatana vizuri na sensor yake, hivyo tulibadilisha nafasi za target bila kuthibitisha na AMM. Kwa sababu ya shinikizo la muda kutoa ndege na haraka ya kumaliza karatasi kabla mkaguzi wa zamu ya pili hajaondoka, mabadiliko hayo hayakuandikwa popote, na ukaguzi wa umbali wa sensor pamoja na PSEU/FSEU uliofuata ulipita bila kubaini tatizo. Zamu inayofuata inatakiwa kuthibitisha tena usakinishaji wa target kulingana na AMM kabla ya kuendelea na hatua zozote za marekebisho.
summary: Ubadilishaji wa target usioandikwa wakati wa marekebisho ya slat ulifichwa na ukaguzi uliofaulu, hivyo unahitaji kuthibitishwa tena zamu ijayo.

entities.text: ukaguzi wa umbali wa sensor pamoja na PSEU/FSEU

narrative_text: Tulikuwa tuna-adjust #11 slat, tukaona ile outboard target kwa auxiliary track haiko aligned na sensor yake, so tuka-swap positions bila hata ku-verify na AMM kwanza. Tulikuwa under pressure ya kutoa ndege na tuka-rush paperwork ili 2nd shift inspector apate ku-stamp kabla ya kuondoka, so ile swap haikuandikwa mahali popote, na hata sensor gap checks na PSEU/FSEU zote zika-pass bila kucatch tatizo. Zamu inayofuata lazima ita-verify tena target installation na AMM kabla ya kuendelea na adjustment steps zozote.
summary: Kuna target swap ambayo haiku-documented wakati wa slat adjustment, ikafichika kwa checks zilizo-pass, so inahitaji ku-verify tena next shift.

narrative_text: A319 #1 engine HP/PRV valve job at gate C20 was picked up mid-progress from midnight shift after the aircraft was changed from a live flight to RON status; engine was closed and reopened due to an unplanned gate move to C26, then HP and PRV valves were replaced and ops checks completed before closing for run. Post-flight it was found in ZZZ1 that the #1 engine T/R had no reverser operation, and the HCU was discovered locked out with a lockout pin that had no streamer attached, so the incoming tech was unaware of the lockout status while working the job. Next shift needs to verify HCU lockout/streamer procedure was followed and confirm reverser system status before further dispatch.
summary: An A319's #1 engine thrust reverser failed to operate after an HCU lockout pin was missed during a valve replacement job disrupted by a gate change.

entities.text: HP and PRV valves were replaced

narrative_text: Kazi ya kubadilisha valve za HP na PRV kwenye engine namba 1 ya ndege ya A319 kwenye gate C20 ilikabidhiwa ikiwa bado inaendelea kutoka shift ya usiku, baada ya ndege kubadilishwa kutoka safari halisi hadi hali ya RON. Engine ilifungwa kisha ikafunguliwa tena kwa sababu ndege ilihitajika kuhamishwa ghafla hadi gate C26, kisha valve za HP na PRV zikabadilishwa na ukaguzi wa uendeshaji ukakamilika kabla ya kufunga engine kwa ajili ya kuwasha. Baada ya ndege kufika ZZZ1, ilibainika kuwa thrust reverser ya engine namba 1 haikufanya kazi, na ikagundulika kuwa HCU ilikuwa imefungwa (locked out) kwa pini bila alama ya utambulisho, hivyo fundi aliyeendeleza kazi hakujua kuhusu hali hiyo. Zamu inayofuata inahitajika kuhakiki utaratibu wa lockout pin na streamer ya HCU, na kuthibitisha hali ya mfumo wa reverser kabla ya ndege kuruhusiwa kuruka tena.
summary: Ndege ya A319 ilipata tatizo la thrust reverser kwenye engine namba 1 baada ya pini ya kufunga HCU kukosa kuonekana wakati wa kazi ya kubadilisha valve iliyokatizwa na mabadiliko ya gate.

entities.text: valve za HP na PRV zikabadilishwa

narrative_text: Ile job ya HP na PRV valve replacement kwa #1 engine ya A319 pale gate C20 nilichukua ikiwa in progress kutoka midnight shift, baada ya flight ku-change from live flight kwenda RON status. Tuli-close engine kisha tuka-reopen tena kwa sababu ndege ilibidi imove ghafla to C26, halafu tuka-replace HP na PRV valves na tuka-complete ops checks kabla ya kufunga engine for run. Baadaye ZZZ1 iligundulika kwamba T/R ya #1 engine haikuwa na reverser operation, na ikaonekana HCU ilikuwa locked out na pin lakini bila streamer, so mimi kama nilikuwa nimeendeleza ile job sikujua kuhusu lockout status hiyo. Next shift wanahitaji ku-verify HCU lockout procedure na streamer, na ku-confirm reverser system status kabla ya dispatch inayofuata.
summary: A319 #1 engine T/R haikuwa na reverser operation baada ya HCU lockout pin kukosa streamer wakati wa valve job iliyodisrupted na gate move.

narrative_text: During storage prep on the A320, Block 10 of the task card for draining oil from both engines was signed off early to close out the shift, with a write-up left for midnight shift to actually perform the drain per the AMM, including LOTO tagging of the cockpit. Midnight crew completed the draining and the log page was later closed after remaining items were finished. Follow-up needed: confirm both engines and gearboxes are verified empty before any future engine run, and review sign-off practice to prevent premature Block 10 closure ahead of actual task completion.
summary: A320 oil-drain task card was signed off before the drain was actually performed, and both engines were later run dry, requiring review of sign-off timing and LOTO compliance.

entities.text: Block 10 of the task card for draining oil

narrative_text: Wakati wa maandalizi ya kuhifadhi ndege ya A320, Block 10 ya task card ya kutoa mafuta kwenye injini zote mbili ilisainiwa mapema ili kufunga zamu, huku maelezo ya kufanya kazi hiyo halisi yakiachwa kwa zamu ya usiku wa manane kufuata AMM, ikiwemo kuweka tag ya LOTO kwenye cockpit. Zamu ya usiku ilikamilisha kutoa mafuta na logbook ilifungwa baadaye baada ya kazi zilizobaki kukamilika. Inahitajika ufuatiliaji: kuhakikisha injini zote mbili na gearbox zimehakikiwa hazina mafuta kabla ya kuwasha injini tena, na kupitia upya utaratibu wa kusaini ili kuzuia kufunga Block 10 mapema kabla kazi halisi haijafanyika.
summary: Task card ya kutoa mafuta ya injini za A320 ilisainiwa kabla ya kazi kufanyika, na baadaye injini zote mbili ziliwashwa bila mafuta, hivyo inahitaji ukaguzi wa utaratibu wa kusaini na uzingatiaji wa LOTO.

entities.text: Block 10 ya task card ya kutoa mafuta

narrative_text: So kwa storage prep ya hiyo A320, Block 10 ya task card ya kudrain oil kwa engines zote mbili ilisign off mapema kabla kazi haijafanyika, ni kwa sababu ilikuwa late in shift, tukaachia write-up kwa midnight shift wafanye actual draining kufuata AMM, pamoja na ku-tag cockpit per LOTO. Midnight crew walimaliza ile draining na log page ikafungwa baadaye baada ya remaining items kukamilika. Follow-up inahitajika: hakikisha both engines na gearboxes zime-verify hazina oil kabla ya engine run yoyote ijayo, na tuangalie tena utaratibu wa sign-off ili kuzuia kufunga Block 10 mapema before kazi halisi imefanyika.
summary: Task card ya kudrain oil ya A320 ilisainiwa before kazi kufanyika, engines zote mbili zikaend up ku-run bila oil, hivyo inahitaji review ya sign-off procedure na LOTO compliance.

narrative_text: B727-200 nose landing gear doors were opened to lube the drag brace mechanism and were closed, locked, and visually confirmed secure before shift change; day shift then took the aircraft for engine run and towing back to the hangar pad with doors still confirmed up and locked. Tow crew later reported the nose gear door dropping during gate positioning, attempted to push it back up themselves, but did not report the issue to anyone before leaving the aircraft. The door subsequently departed the aircraft on takeoff, causing an air turn back; incoming shift needs to inspect nose gear door rigging/lock mechanism and review tow crew handling procedures before further dispatch.
summary: A B727 nose gear door, previously serviced and confirmed secure, later separated in flight after an unreported handling issue by a tow crew, prompting an air turn back and requiring follow-up inspection.

narrative_text: Milango ya gia ya mbele ya ndege ya B727-200 ilifunguliwa kwa ajili ya kupaka mafuta kwenye drag brace, kisha ikafungwa na kuhakikishiwa usalama kabla ya mabadiliko ya zamu. Zamu ya mchana ilichukua ndege kwa ajili ya kuendesha injini na kuivuta hadi eneo la hangar, huku milango ikiwa bado imefungwa vizuri. Baadaye wafanyakazi wa kuvuta ndege waliripoti kuwa mlango wa gia ya mbele ulidondoka wakati wa kuipeleka gate, walijaribu kuurudisha lakini hawakumjulisha yeyote kabla ya kuondoka; mlango huo hatimaye ulitoka wakati wa kuruka na ndege kulazimika kurudi. Zamu inayoingia inatakiwa kukagua mfumo wa kufunga mlango wa gia ya mbele na kufuatilia utaratibu wa wafanyakazi wa kuvuta ndege kabla ya safari nyingine.
summary: Mlango wa gia ya mbele ya ndege ya B727 uliokuwa umehudumiwa na kuthibitishwa salama ulitoka wakati wa kuruka baada ya tatizo lisiloripotiwa la wafanyakazi wa kuvuta ndege, na kusababisha ndege kurudi.

narrative_text: Tulifungua nose gear doors za B727-200 ili tuweze ku-lube drag brace mechanism vizuri, na baada ya kumaliza tuliclose na kulock zote mbili, tuka-confirm ziko secure kabla ya shift change. Day shift walichukua aircraft kwa engine run kisha wakaitow nyuma hangar pad, doors zikiwa bado zime-lock properly wakati huo. Baadaye tow crew wame-report kwamba nose gear door ilianguka wakati wa kuipeleka gate, walitry kui-push up lakini hawakumwambia mtu yeyote before wao ku-leave aircraft pale. Door ile iliondoka completely during takeoff na ikasababisha air turn back, so incoming shift wanahitaji ku-inspect nose gear door rigging na ku-review vile tow crew wanahandle aircraft kabla ya dispatch nyingine.
summary: Nose gear door ya B727 iliyokuwa imeserviced na kuconfirmiwa secure ilianguka mid-flight baada ya tatizo la tow crew ambalo halikureportiwa, na kusababisha air turn back.
